literature.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 该综述共确定了 550 项研究,其中包括 505 项初步研究和 45 项系统评价。大多数研究侧重于针对成人和儿童混合人群的社区一级干预措施,主要集中在南美洲和南亚的高 患病率 地区。社区教育是研究最广泛的干预领域,有 47 个 RCT 和 140 个 NSI。由于方法学上的缺陷,大多数系统评价被评为低质量或极低质量。证据差距图强调需要进行更多高质量的研究,特别是在 疫苗、环境干预措施和 媒介 控制策略方面。 [10.1002/14651858.cd016299.pub2]
化合物16被确定为新型nSMase2抑制剂,硫代吡啶并嘧啶酮衍生物在细胞水平实验中展现出对登革病毒的抗病毒药物活性。 [10.1002/cmdc.70452]
研究结果揭示了从低风险登革热流行模式向高风险登革热流行模式的转变,并伴随城市间同步化程度的显著提升。研究还表明,气候异常可增加登革热流行的许可日数量。结果提示此类许可日与登革热同步化显著相关。 [10.1098/rsif.2026.0438]
多个区域的年气候变量与蚊媒密度相关,其中降雨频率对埃及伊蚊密度的影响强于累积降雨量;温度与滞后侵扰指数与两种蚊媒及登革热发病率均显示强关联,且滞后效应可持续至8周。 [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014201]
确定了miR-146a、miR-150、miR-378、miR-21-5p及miR-1246等关键miRNA,其可调控免疫应答、炎症及病毒复制。荟萃分析显示循环miRNA具有高诊断准确性,AUC值范围为0.79至1.00,但存在显著统计异质性(I平方值超过89%)。 [10.1007/s10142-026-02014-8]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The review identified 550 studies in total, comprising 505 primary studies and 45 systematic reviews. Most studies focused on community-level interventions with mixed adult and child populations, predominantly in high-prevalence regions of South America and South Asia. [10.1002/14651858.cd016299.pub2]
Compound 16 was identified as a novel nSMase2 inhibitor, and the thienopyrimidinone derivatives demonstrated antiviral activity against Dengue virus in cell-based assays. [10.1002/cmdc.70452]

Our results reveal a transition from a low-transmission regime to a high-transmission regime accompanied by a marked increase in synchronization across cities. We also show that climate anomalies increase the number of permissive days for dengue transmission. [10.1098/rsif.2026.0438]

Annual climatic variables were associated with mosquito abundance in several districts, with rainfall frequency showing a stronger effect on Aedes aegypti abundance than accumulated rainfall, and temperature and lagged infestation indices showing strong associations with both species and dengue incidence, with lag effects detected up to eight weeks. [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014201]
Key miRNAs such as miR-146a, miR-150, miR-378, miR-21-5p, and miR-1246 were identified as regulators of immune responses, inflammation, and viral replication. [10.1007/s10142-026-02014-8]

key_findings_en: Multiple Pacific territories reported dengue outbreaks or elevated transmission with serotype-specific alerts: American Samoa (DENV-1 & DENV-2 blue alert), Marshall Islands (DENV-? red alert), Samoa (DENV-1 & DENV-2 blue alert), Vanuatu (DENV-1 red alert), Wallis and Futuna (DENV-1 red alert). Pinellas County confirmed two locally acquired dengue fever cases, marking the first local transmission in over 15 years. The cases were reported by the Florida Department of Health in Pinellas County. [news-5c043e32d130bf8e]

papers.title: Guillain-Barré syndrome following dengue infection in a child in Lebanon: a case report and review of the literature
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue virus infection is increasingly recognized as a cause of neurological complications, including post-infectious immune-mediated neuropathies such as Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS). We report a rare pediatric case from Lebanon with anti-GD1a positivity, highlighting the evolving epidemiology of dengue and the importance of recognizing neurological complications in emerging transmission settings. CASE PRESENTATION: A previously healthy 3-year-old girl residing in Ghana presented with progressive bilateral lower extremity pain and refusal to bear weight approximately two weeks after returning from a one-week trip to Iraq and nine weeks after returning to Lebanon from Ghana. Neurological examination revealed evolving reflex changes from hyperreflexia to areflexia with preserved sensation. Cerebrospinal fluid demonstrated albuminocytologic dissociation, while spinal magnetic resonance imaging showed cauda equina nerve-root enhancement. Electrophysiological studies supported a demyelinating polyneuropathy. Dengue serology supported recent primary infection (initial IgM positivity with negative IgG, with subsequent IgG seroconversion), and antiganglioside testing revealed anti-GD1a positivity. The patient was treated with intravenous immunoglobulin (2 g/kg over 2 days), resulting in rapid clinical improvement and near-complete recovery within two weeks. CONCLUSION: This case highlights dengue as a potential trigger of GBS in young children through autoimmune mechanisms involving antiganglioside antibodies. It underscores the expanding range of dengue infection to previously non-endemic countries like Lebanon, potentially driven by climate change, expanding vector distribution, and increasing international travel. This raises the importance of considering dengue in the differential diagnosis of acute neuropathies in emerging regions such as the Middle East, particularly in the context of increasing global travel and climate change-induced vector expansion.

papers.title: Interventions for preventing dengue: a mapping review.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue remains a pressing global health challenge, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMIC). Despite a growing volume of research on prevention strategies, there is a notable lack of consolidated, high-level research capturing the full scope of existing knowledge. The current evidence landscape is fragmented, with studies varying widely in design, focus, and quality. A structured map that includes both primary studies and systematic reviews is urgently needed. Such evidence and gap maps (EGMs) serve as a decision-support tool for funders, policymakers, and researchers by identifying where research exists and where future investments are most needed. comprehensively identify the published literature on dengue prevention strategies; 2. critically appraise systematic reviews; 3. present the findings of objectives 1 and 2 in a single evidence gap map; and 4. identify critical knowledge gaps to inform future primary studies and systematic reviews. SEARCH METHODS: We searched MEDLINE (Ovid), Embase (Ovid), CINAHL (EBSCO), Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL), Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews (CDSR) in the Cochrane Library, and LILACS (BIREME) on 6 August 2025. We did not apply any date or language restrictions to the searches. SELECTION CRITERIA: We included randomised controlled trials (RCTs), quasi-randomised trials, non-randomised studies of interventions (NRSIs) and systematic reviews. NRSIs had to have a comparator. We included study designs such as cohort studies, interrupted time series designs, controlled before-after studies, and case-control studies. We did not include case studies or animal studies conducted in a laboratory or semi-field environment. We did not have any restrictions on date or language of publication. We included studies that compared dengue prevention strategies against placebo, no intervention, or usual care. We developed intervention and outcomes categories through a structured stakeholder engagement process and an existing theoretical framework. DATA COLLECTION AND ANALYSIS: We used Cochrane Crowd, Cochrane's citizen science platform designed to host classification tasks, to help identify and describe health-related research. The results collectively identified by the Crowd as being potentially relevant to the EGM were then imported into EPPI Reviewer for further assessment and coding by the author team. Two review authors independently extracted data from the included studies using a structured coding framework developed during the pilot stage. Following coding, we exported data from EPPI Reviewer to EPPI Mapper to generate an interactive, online map that visually displays the distribution of evidence and identifies key gaps by intervention and outcome. We sought to identify evidence and map it, but did not seek to provide a critical appraisal of that evidence. However, to support systematic review teams in understanding where there are evidence synthesis gaps, and to minimise research duplication, we decided to critically appraise the systematic reviews. Two review authors independently appraised the quality of systematic reviews, using A MeaSurement Tool to Assess Systematic Reviews (AMSTAR 2). We partnered with Instituto Veredas, a Brazilian non-governmental organisation, that aims to build bridges between public management, academia, and civil society, to conduct stakeholder engagement. MAIN RESULTS: The searches identified 20,355 records. After deduplication, we screened 16,468 titles and abstracts, then assessed 720 full-text articles for further eligibility. In total, we included 550 studies in the EGM. Evidence from primary studies We included a total of 505 primary studies, comprising 197 RCTs and 308 NRSIs, with 219 published in the past decade. Most studies were conducted at the community level with mixed adult and child populations, predominantly in high-prevalence regions of South America and South Asia. Brazil accounted for the largest share of studies (64 studies), and Aedes aegypti was the most frequently targeted vector species. Of our five main intervention domains (vaccines, environmental, community education, targetting of aquatic stages of the vector and targetting of adult vectors), community education was the most extensively studied (47 RCTs and 140 NRSIs), largely focusing on behavioural and entomological outcomes. These interventions overlapped with vector control interventions targeting both aquatic and adult stages of the mosquito. Evidence from systematic reviews We included 45 systematic reviews. We rated only eight as high or moderate quality using the AMSTAR 2 tool, with the majority classified as low or critically low quality due to methodological weaknesses. Common deficiencies included lack of protocol registration, inadequate justification for study exclusions, and insufficient consideration of risk of bias in interpreting findings. Of the eight high- or moderate-quality reviews, most of which evaluated multiple interventions, two included environmental interventions, three evaluated community education, four assessed vaccines, one evaluated vector control interventions exclusively targeting aquatic stages, and three included vector control of adult mosquitoes. analysis.scope_and_question: This review aimed to map the evidence on interventions for preventing dengue, focusing on dengue viruses 1–4 and dengue disease. The central question was to identify and categorize the existing literature on dengue prevention strategies, including primary studies and systematic reviews, to support decision-making for future research and public health actions. The topic boundary was strictly defined to include only dengue-related entities, excluding other flaviviruses unless explicitly linked to dengue-specific evidence.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base was derived from a comprehensive search of MEDLINE (Ovid), Embase (Ovid), CINAHL (EBSCO), Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL), Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews (CDSR) in the Cochrane Library, and LILACS (BIREME) on 6 August 2025. No date or language restrictions were applied. The review included randomised controlled trials (RCTs), quasi-randomised trials, non-randomised studies of interventions (NRSIs), and systematic reviews. A structured coding framework was developed during a pilot stage, and data were extracted using this framework. The quality of systematic reviews was assessed using the AMSTAR 2 tool, with only eight rated as high or moderate quality.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review identified 550 studies in total, comprising 505 primary studies and 45 systematic reviews. Most studies focused on community-level interventions with mixed adult and child populations, predominantly in high-prevalence regions of South America and South Asia. Community education was the most extensively studied intervention domain, with 47 RCTs and 140 NRSIs. The majority of systematic reviews were rated as low or critically low quality due to methodological weaknesses. The evidence gap map highlighted the need for more high-quality research, particularly on vaccines, environmental interventions, and vector control strategies.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence landscape was described as fragmented, with studies varying widely in design, focus, and quality. The majority of systematic reviews were of low or critically low quality, indicating methodological limitations in the synthesis of evidence. There was a notable lack of consolidated, high-level research capturing the full scope of existing knowledge. Additionally, the review identified gaps in research on specific interventions, such as vaccines and environmental strategies, and highlighted the need for more studies in certain regions and populations.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasized the importance of identifying critical knowledge gaps to inform future primary studies and systematic reviews. It recommended prioritizing high-quality research on vaccines, environmental interventions, and vector control strategies. Stakeholder engagement was conducted with Instituto Veredas to ensure that the findings were relevant to public health decision-making. The results were intended to serve as a decision-support tool for funders, policymakers, and researchers, guiding where future investments in research and public health actions are most needed.

analysis.summary_en: This review maps the evidence on interventions for preventing dengue, focusing on dengue viruses 1–4 and dengue disease. It identified 550 studies, including 505 primary studies and 45 systematic reviews, highlighting the need for more high-quality research. Community education was the most studied intervention, but most systematic reviews were rated as low or critically low quality. The review underscores the importance of addressing evidence gaps in vaccines, environmental strategies, and vector control, particularly in high-prevalence regions. It serves as a decision-support tool for future research and public health actions.

Aligning future research agendas with these gaps may substantially enhance the usability of the evidence for public health decision-making, particularly in endemic and resource-constrained settings. analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述旨在绘制登革热预防干预的证据图谱,重点关注 登革病毒 1–4 与登革热疾病本身。核心问题是识别并分类现有的登革热预防策略文献,包括原始研究和系统评价,以支持未来研究和公共卫生行动的决策。研究范围严格限定为仅涉及登革热相关实体,除非明确与登革热特定证据相连,否则不包括其他黄病毒。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 证据基础来源于 2025 年 8 月 6 日对 MEDLINE (Ovid)、Embase (Ovid)、CINAHL (EBSCO)、Cochrane 对照试验中央注册库 (CENTRAL)、Cochrane 图书馆的 Cochrane 系统评价数据库 (CDSR) 和 LILACS (BIREME) 的全面检索。没有应用日期或语言限制。该综述包括随机对照试验(RCT)、半随机试验、非随机干预研究(NRSI)和系统评价。在试点阶段开发了结构化编码框架,并使用该框架提取数据。使用 AMSTAR 2 工具评估系统评价的质量,只有 8 个评价为高质量或中等质量。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述共确定了 550 项研究,其中包括 505 项初步研究和 45 项系统评价。大多数研究侧重于针对成人和儿童混合人群的社区一级干预措施,主要集中在南美洲和南亚的高 患病率 地区。社区教育是研究最广泛的干预领域,有 47 个 RCT 和 140 个 NSI。由于方法学上的缺陷,大多数系统评价被评为低质量或极低质量。证据差距图强调需要进行更多高质量的研究,特别是在 疫苗、环境干预措施和 媒介 控制策略方面。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 证据情况被描述为支离破碎,研究在设计、重点和质量上差异很大。大多数系统评价的质量较低或极低,表明证据综合的方法学局限性。明显缺乏综合的、高水平的研究来捕获现有知识的全部范围。此外,该审查还发现了特定干预措施(例如 疫苗 和环境战略)的研究差距,并强调需要在某些地区和人群中进行更多研究。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查强调了确定关键知识差距的重要性,以便为未来的初步研究和系统审查提供信息。它建议优先考虑 疫苗、环境干预措施和 媒介 控制策略的高质量研究。与 Instituto Veredas 进行了利益相关者参与,以确保研究结果与公共卫生决策相关。研究结果旨在作为资助者、政策制定者和研究人员的决策支持工具,指导未来最需要的研究和公共卫生行动投资。

papers.title: Post-acute and long-term cardiovascular effects following dengue infection: A systematic review protocol.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIM: Dengue is a major arboviral disease in tropical and subtropical regions, traditionally regarded as an acute, self-limiting illness. However, emerging evidence suggests that its consequences may extend beyond the acute phase, especially involving the cardiovascular system. Reported manifestations include major adverse cardiovascular events, arrhythmias, thromboembolic complications, subclinical myocardial dysfunction, endothelial dysfunction, and vascular changes. Evidence remains fragmented due to variation in study designs, population characteristics, outcome definitions, and follow-up durations. This systematic review aims to appraise and synthesise evidence on post-acute and long-term cardiovascular outcomes following dengue infection, including their spectrum, comparative risk, and determinants. METHODS AND ANALYSIS: This protocol outlines a systematic review of cardiovascular outcomes in the post-acute and long-term phases of dengue infection. Human studies of any age group will be included if they report cardiovascular outcomes at least 4 weeks after acute dengue illness. Laboratory-confirmed dengue will be prioritised for primary comparative synthesis; clinically diagnosed dengue will contribute to descriptive synthesis and, where appropriate, subgroup or sensitivity analyses. Studies using cohort, case-control, cross-sectional, or case-series designs will be eligible. Comparative studies with dengue-negative or clearly defined reference controls will estimate effects where available, while non-comparative follow-up studies will contribute to descriptive synthesis. Outcomes will include major clinical cardiovascular events, including stroke or transient ischaemic attacks, subclinical cardiac or vascular abnormalities, and cardiovascular-related biomarkers. Searches will be conducted in PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Cochrane Library, CINAHL, ScienceDirect, ProQuest, and Google Scholar. Two reviewers will independently perform screening, data extraction, and risk-of-bias and critical appraisal assessments. Evidence will be synthesized narratively; where comparable, random-effects meta-analysis and Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) assessment will be conducted. PROSPERO registration: CRD420261354181. DISCUSSION: This review will summarize post-dengue cardiovascular sequelae and identify evidence gaps. Findings may clarify post-dengue cardiovascular risk and inform future research, clinical follow-up, and public health planning in dengue-endemic settings.
authors: Manikka H. M. Thisara S. Perera

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热是热带和亚热带地区的主要虫媒病毒疾病,传统上被视为一种急性自限性疾病。然而,新兴证据表明其影响可能超出急性期,特别是涉及心血管系统。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本系统性综述方案概述了一项针对报告急性登革热发病至少4周后心血管结局的人类研究的研究。采用队列研究、病例对照、横断面或病例系列设计的研究均符合纳入条件。
elements_zh.methods: 证据将以叙述性综合形式呈现;在可比较情况下,将进行随机效应荟萃分析及推荐分级评估、制定和评价(GRADE)评估。两名审稿人将独立完成筛选、数据提取及偏倚风险与关键评估。
elements_zh.main_results: 已报道的临床表现包括重大不良心血管事件、心律失常、血栓栓塞并发症、亚临床心肌功能障碍、内皮功能障碍及血管改变。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本综述将总结登革热后心血管后遗症,并识别证据缺口。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可能阐明登革热后心血管风险,并为未来研究、临床随访及登革热流行地区的公共卫生规划提供参考。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于研究设计、人群特征、结局定义及随访时长的差异,现有证据仍较为零散。

Evidence will be synthesized narratively; where comparable, random-effects meta-analysis and Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) assessment will be conducted. Findings may clarify post-dengue cardiovascular risk and inform future research, clinical follow-up, and public health planning in dengue-endemic settings.

papers.title: Genomic and epidemiological evidence linking a pre-season dengue case to local overwintering transmission in Guangdong, China.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: In March 2025, Guangdong Province reported China's earliest locally acquired dengue case, occurring two months before the typical transmission season. This unprecedented event raised critical questions about potential overwintering transmission mechanisms in subtropical regions. The investigation sought to determine whether this case represented a resurgence from the 2024 outbreak or a new importation event. METHODS: We conducted comprehensive epidemiological, entomological, and laboratory investigations to trace the origin of infection. Standardized case interviews were conducted to record the patient's 14-day exposure history, including travel patterns. A targeted investigation within a 100-meter radius of the case exposure sites was conducted. Active surveillance and entomological assessments-including Breteau Index calculations and ovitrap deployment-were implemented within 200-meter radius of exposure sites. Serum samples were tested for DENV using real-time RT-PCR, NS1 antigen, and IgM/IgG antibodies. The envelope (E) gene was sequenced using Sanger sequencing, followed by phylogenetic analysis against global variants with the Neighbor-Joining method in MEGA software. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: Genomic analysis of the envelope (E) gene revealed 99.93% identity between the case's dengue virus serotype 1 strain and a locally acquired 2024 case, differing by only a single-nucleotide variant. The high-risk area showed a relatively high dengue prevalence within the previous outbreak year. Meteorological data confirmed that 22 of 26 days during the exposure window met temperature thresholds (20-25°C) conducive to mosquito activity. CONCLUSIONS: This investigation provides genomic and epidemiological evidence suggesting overwintering dengue transmission in China. The findings are consistent with local persistence from the 2024 outbreak, with vertical transmission in overwintering mosquitoes as a leading hypothesis.. These results challenge traditional assumptions about seasonal transmission patterns and underscore the need for year-round vector surveillance in subtropical regions experiencing climate warming.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 2025年3月,广东省报告了中国最早的本地获得性登革热病例,发生时间较典型登革热流行季提前两个月。这一前所未有的事件引发了关于登革热在亚热带地区潜在越冬机制的关键问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究于 2025 年 3 月在中国广东省进行,重点关注单个季前登革热病例。对病例暴露地点半径100米范围内进行有针对性排查。
elements_zh.methods: 为追踪感染源,开展了综合流行病学、媒介生物学与实验室调查。采用标准化病例访谈记录患者14天暴露史,包括旅行模式。采用实时RT-PCR、NS1抗原及IgM/IgG抗体检测血清样本中的登革病毒。利用Sanger测序对包膜(E)基因进行测序,随后在MEGA软件中采用邻接法对全球变异株进行系统发育分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 包膜(E)基因基因组分析显示,该病例登革病毒血清型1毒株与当地2024年获得性病例的同源性为99.93%,仅存在单核苷酸变异。高风险区域在前一登革热流行年内显示相对较高的登革热媒介密度。气象数据证实,在26天的暴露窗口期内,有22天满足20-25°C的温度阈值,有利于蚊媒活动。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本次调查提供了基因组与流行病学证据,提示中国存在登革热越冬现象。研究结果与2024年登革热流行后的本地持续存在一致,垂直传播是越冬蚊媒的主要假说。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果挑战了传统季节性登革热模式的假设,并强调在经历气候变暖的亚热带地区开展全年监测与媒介控制的必要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于单一病例的关注范围及其他登革热传播途径的可能性。基因组分析与气象数据支持登革热越冬假说,证据较为充分。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:2025年3月,广东省报告了中国最早的本地获得性登革热病例,发生时间较典型登革热流行季提前两个月。这一前所未有的事件引发了关于登革热在亚热带地区潜在越冬机制的关键问题。本次调查旨在确定该病例是否代表2024年登革热流行后的再次暴发,或为一起新的输入性事件。方法:为追踪感染源,开展了综合流行病学、媒介生物学与实验室调查。采用标准化病例访谈记录患者14天暴露史,包括旅行模式。在距离暴露场所100米范围内开展了针对性调查。在距离暴露场所200米范围内实施了主动登革热媒介与媒介生物学评估,包括布雷图指数计算与诱卵器布放。采用实时RT-PCR、NS1抗原及IgM/IgG抗体检测血清样本中的登革病毒。利用Sanger测序对包膜(E)基因进行测序,随后在MEGA软件中采用邻接法对全球变异株进行系统发育分析。主要发现:包膜(E)基因基因组分析显示,该病例登革病毒血清型1毒株与当地2024年获得性病例的同源性为99.93%,仅存在单核苷酸变异。高风险区域在前一登革热流行年内显示相对较高的登革热媒介密度。气象数据证实,在26天的暴露窗口期内,有22天满足20-25°C的温度阈值,有利于蚊媒活动。结论:本次调查提供了基因组与流行病学证据,提示中国存在登革热越冬现象。研究结果与2024年登革热流行后的本地持续存在一致,垂直传播是越冬蚊媒的主要假说。这些结果挑战了传统季节性登革热模式的假设,并强调在经历气候变暖的亚热带地区开展全年监测与媒介控制的必要性。

papers.title: Emerging and Re-Emerging Viral Pathogens in Oncolytic Virotherapy: A Comprehensive Review.
papers.abstract: Oncolytic virotherapy has recently emerged as a promising immuno-oncological strategy, utilising the natural cytolytic potentials of viral pathogens to selectively target and destroy malignant cells. Although various engineered viruses, such as adenoviruses, vaccinia virus, and herpes simplex virus, are currently in clinical evaluation, emerging and re-emerging viruses with intrinsic oncolytic potential, including Zika virus (ZIKV), Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), Dengue virus (DENV), and West Nile virus (WNV), have also shown promising results. These emerging and re-emerging viral pathogens show specific tumour tropism, immune evasion strategies, and immunogenic cell death mechanisms that could be harnessed for next-generation therapeutic platforms. Nonetheless, concerns related to safety, viral pathogenicity, host immune responses, and the risk of uncontrolled viral dissemination present significant translational challenges. The present review provides a comprehensive overview of novel viral candidates, including ZIKV, SARS-CoV-2, DENV, and WNV, in oncolytic virotherapy, their molecular mechanisms of tumour targeting, and current advancements in genetic engineering aimed at improving therapeutic efficacy and biosafety. Moreover, this review describes clinical perspectives, regulatory considerations, and future directions in integrating emerging virotherapeutic agents into precision oncology.

source_records.abstract: Oncolytic virotherapy has recently emerged as a promising immuno-oncological strategy, utilising the natural cytolytic potentials of viral pathogens to selectively target and destroy malignant cells. Although various engineered viruses, such as adenoviruses, vaccinia virus, and herpes simplex virus, are currently in clinical evaluation, emerging and re-emerging viruses with intrinsic oncolytic potential, including Zika virus (ZIKV), Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), Dengue virus (DENV), and West Nile virus (WNV), have also shown promising results. These emerging and re-emerging viral pathogens show specific tumour tropism, immune evasion strategies, and immunogenic cell death mechanisms that could be harnessed for next-generation therapeutic platforms. Nonetheless, concerns related to safety, viral pathogenicity, host immune responses, and the risk of uncontrolled viral dissemination present significant translational challenges. The present review provides a comprehensive overview of novel viral candidates, including ZIKV, SARS-CoV-2, DENV, and WNV, in oncolytic virotherapy, their molecular mechanisms of tumour targeting, and current advancements in genetic engineering aimed at improving therapeutic efficacy and biosafety. Moreover, this review describes clinical perspectives, regulatory considerations, and future directions in integrating emerging virotherapeutic agents into precision oncology.

papers.abstract_zh: 溶瘤病毒疗法最近成为一种有前途的免疫肿瘤学策略,利用病毒病原体的天然溶细胞潜力来选择性地靶向和破坏恶性细胞。尽管各种工程病毒,如腺病毒、牛痘病毒和单纯疱疹病毒,目前正处于临床评估阶段,但具有内在溶瘤潜力的新出现和重新出现的病毒,包括寨卡病毒(ZIKV)、严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(SARS-CoV-2)、登革病毒(DENV)和西尼罗河病毒(WNV)也显示出有希望的结果。这些新出现和重新出现的病毒病原体表现出特定的肿瘤趋向性、免疫逃避策略和免疫原性细胞死亡机制,可用于下一代治疗平台。尽管如此,与安全性、病毒致病性、宿主 免疫应答 以及不受控制的病毒传播风险相关的担忧提出了重大的转化挑战。本综述全面概述了溶瘤病毒治疗中的新型候选病毒,包括 ZIKV、SARS-CoV-2、DENV 和 WNV、它们的肿瘤靶向分子机制,以及旨在提高治疗效果和生物安全性的基因工程的最新进展。此外,这篇综述描述了将新兴病毒治疗药物整合到精准肿瘤学中的临床观点、监管考虑因素和未来方向。

papers.title: Climate-driven spatiotemporal dynamics of Aedes infestation and dengue transmission in Porto Alegre, Southern Brazil
papers.abstract: Dengue transmission is strongly influenced by climatic conditions that affect mosquito population dynamics and virus circulation. In Southern Brazil, where dengue historically occurred at low levels, recent climatic anomalies may be contributing to the expansion of Aedes vectors and increased local dengue incidence. This study investigated the spatiotemporal association between climatic variables, Aedes infestation and dengue cases in Porto Alegre (Southern Brazil, from 2018 to 2025). Entomological, surveillance and climatic data were analyzed using Moran’s I and LISA for spatial association, Kendall correlation, polynomial regression and LASSO to identify relevant drivers and develop predictive models of mosquito infestation and dengue incidence. Strong spatial association between Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus was observed, with persistent local clusters detected across all years. Annual climatic variables were associated with mosquito abundance in several districts. Overall, rainfall frequency had a stronger effect on Ae. aegypti abundance than accumulated rainfall. Temperature and lagged infestation indices showed strong associations with both species and dengue incidence, with lag effects detected up to eight weeks. Predictive models demonstrated good agreement between observed and predicted values, particularly at low to moderate infestation levels. Lagged variables were consistently retained in both mosquito abundance and dengue incidence models, highlighting the importance of temporal predictors in anticipating vector dynamics and dengue risk. This approach is broadly applicable for predicting Aedes infestation and disease incidence and it underscores the importance of integrating entomological and climatic surveillance data to enhance anticipation and early detection of dengue risk periods in large urban settings and inform more effective public health interventions.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革热传播受气候条件强烈影响,这些条件会影响蚊媒种群动态与病毒循环。在巴西南部,登革热历史上发病水平较低,但近期气候异常可能正在推动埃及伊蚊媒介种群扩张并增加当地登革热发病率发病。本研究调查了气候变量、埃及伊蚊侵扰与登革热病例在阿雷格里港(巴西南部,2018–2025年)的时空关联。研究采用了蚊媒学、监测与气候数据,并运用Moran’s I与LISA进行空间关联分析、Kendall相关性分析、多项式回归与LASSO,以识别关键驱动因子并构建蚊媒侵扰与登革热发病率的预测模型。埃及伊蚊与白纹伊蚊间存在显著空间关联,且在所有年份均检测到持续的局部聚类。多个区域的年气候变量与蚊媒密度相关。总体而言,降雨频率对埃及伊蚊密度的影响强于累积降雨量。温度与滞后侵扰指数与两种蚊媒及登革热发病率均显示强关联,且滞后效应可持续至8周。预测模型在观测值与预测值间显示出良好一致性,尤以低至中等侵扰水平为佳。滞后变量在蚊媒密度与登革热发病率模型中均被持续保留,凸显时间预测变量在预测媒介动态与登革热风险中的重要性。该方法可广泛用于预测埃及伊蚊侵扰与疾病发病率,并强调整合蚊媒学与气候监测数据以提升对登革热高风险期的预测与早期检测能力,从而为大型城市环境中的公共卫生干预提供更有效的信息支撑。

papers.title: Trophoblast metabolic reprogramming triggers adverse pregnancy outcomes during DENV-2 infection in mice
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Adverse pregnancy outcomes associated with dengue virus (DENV) infection are a severe manifestation of dengue fever; however, we still poorly understand the underlying mechanisms. Trophoblast dysfunction in the placenta contributes centrally to various pregnancy complications. As the functional unit of the placenta, the syncytiotrophoblast (STB) requires continuous fusion of precursor trophoblasts and adequate energy supply. In this study, we established a model of adverse pregnancy by infecting Ifnar 1 −/− pregnant mice with DENV-2. We did not detect viral replication within the placental trophoblast layer but observed substantial structural damage to the STB. RNA-seq analysis demonstrated that precursor trophoblasts exhibit disrupted glucose metabolism, and placental tissue upregulates pro-fusion genes—yet fails to complete syncytialization. Metabolic assays revealed reduced ATP levels and elevated lactate concentrations, indicating that an inadequate energy supply impedes trophoblast differentiation. Treatment with the glycolytic inhibitor 2-DG restored oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) activity in the placenta and markedly improved pathological outcomes. Further mechanistic studies established that DENV infection induces oxidative stress, which activates hypoxia-inducible factor Hif1α, leading to subsequent upregulation of lactate dehydrogenase (LDHA) expression. We identify this cascade as a fundamental mechanism underlying metabolic reprogramming in trophoblasts. Our findings not only clarify the key pathological processes driving DENV-induced adverse pregnancy outcomes but also propose novel therapeutic strategies for clinical intervention. IMPORTANCE Dengue virus infection during pregnancy is linked to adverse fetal outcomes, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. In Ifnar 1 −/− pregnant mice, we show that fetal growth restriction is driven by disruption of the maternal environment that impairs placental function. We identify syncytiotrophoblast damage and defective trophoblast fusion despite compensatory upregulation of pro-fusion genes. Placental metabolic analysis reveals a shift from oxidative phosphorylation to glycolysis, accompanied by reduced ATP production and impaired syncytialization. Inhibition of glycolysis in vivo partially restores placental structure and improves fetal outcomes, supporting a key role for metabolic reprogramming. Mechanistically, ROS activates HIF-1α and upregulates its downstream target LDHA, thereby linking metabolic reprogramming to placental dysfunction and highlighting this pathway as a potential therapeutic target. These findings reveal a mechanism underlying DENV-associated pregnancy complications and highlight metabolic pathways as potential therapeutic targets.

As the functional unit of the placenta, the syncytiotrophoblast (STB) requires continuous fusion of precursor trophoblasts and adequate energy supply. In this study, we established a model of adverse pregnancy by infecting Ifnar 1 −/− pregnant mice with DENV-2. We did not detect viral replication within the placental trophoblast layer but observed substantial structural damage to the STB. RNA-seq analysis demonstrated that precursor trophoblasts exhibit disrupted glucose metabolism, and placental tissue upregulates pro-fusion genes—yet fails to complete syncytialization. Metabolic assays revealed reduced ATP levels and elevated lactate concentrations, indicating that an inadequate energy supply impedes trophoblast differentiation. Treatment with the glycolytic inhibitor 2-DG restored oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) activity in the placenta and markedly improved pathological outcomes. Further mechanistic studies established that DENV infection induces oxidative stress, which activates hypoxia-inducible factor Hif1α, leading to subsequent upregulation of lactate dehydrogenase (LDHA) expression. We identify this cascade as a fundamental mechanism underlying metabolic reprogramming in trophoblasts. Our findings not only clarify the key pathological processes driving DENV-induced adverse pregnancy outcomes but also propose novel therapeutic strategies for clinical intervention. IMPORTANCE Dengue virus infection during pregnancy is linked to adverse fetal outcomes, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. In Ifnar 1 −/− pregnant mice, we show that fetal growth restriction is driven by disruption of the maternal environment that impairs placental function. We identify syncytiotrophoblast damage and defective trophoblast fusion despite compensatory upregulation of pro-fusion genes. Placental metabolic analysis reveals a shift from oxidative phosphorylation to glycolysis, accompanied by reduced ATP production and impaired syncytialization. Inhibition of glycolysis in vivo partially restores placental structure and improves fetal outcomes, supporting a key role for metabolic reprogramming. Mechanistically, ROS activates HIF-1α and upregulates its downstream target LDHA, thereby linking metabolic reprogramming to placental dysfunction and highlighting this pathway as a potential therapeutic target. These findings reveal a mechanism underlying DENV-associated pregnancy complications and highlight metabolic pathways as potential therapeutic targets.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue virus (DENV) infection during pregnancy is linked to adverse fetal outcomes, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. The study aimed to investigate how DENV infection affects placental function and leads to adverse pregnancy outcomes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a model of adverse pregnancy by infecting Ifnar 1 −/− pregnant mice with DENV-2. The research focused on placental trophoblasts and their structural and metabolic changes during infection.
analysis.methods: RNA-seq analysis was used to study gene expression in precursor trophoblasts and placental tissue. Metabolic assays measured ATP levels and lactate concentrations to assess energy supply and its impact on trophoblast differentiation. The glycolytic inhibitor 2-DG was administered to evaluate its effect on placental function.
analysis.main_results: RNA-seq analysis showed disrupted glucose metabolism in precursor trophoblasts and upregulated pro-fusion genes in placental tissue, yet syncytialization was not completed. Metabolic assays revealed reduced ATP levels and elevated lactate concentrations, indicating impaired energy supply and trophoblast differentiation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that DENV infection disrupts placental function through metabolic reprogramming, which impairs trophoblast fusion and leads to adverse pregnancy outcomes. This study identifies a novel mechanism linking metabolic changes to placental dysfunction.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the mechanisms of DENV-induced adverse pregnancy outcomes and highlight metabolic pathways as potential therapeutic targets for improving maternal and fetal health.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an animal model, which may not fully represent human pregnancy. The evidence is strong as it directly links DENV infection to metabolic changes and structural damage in the placenta, supporting the proposed mechanism.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how DENV-2 infection during pregnancy in Ifnar 1 −/− mice leads to adverse pregnancy outcomes. It demonstrates that DENV-2 infection causes structural damage to the syncytiotrophoblast and disrupts glucose metabolism, resulting in reduced ATP levels and impaired trophoblast fusion. RNA-seq analysis and metabolic assays reveal these changes, while treatment with the glycolytic inhibitor 2-DG partially restores placental function and improves fetal outcomes. The findings suggest that metabolic reprogramming, driven by oxidative stress and HIF-1α activation, is a key mechanism underlying DENV-associated pregnancy complications. These results highlight potential therapeutic strategies targeting metabolic pathways to mitigate adverse outcomes in dengue-infected pregnancies.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 与登革病毒(DENV)感染相关的不良妊娠结局是登革热的严重临床表现之一;然而,其潜在机制仍不明确。胎盘滋养层功能障碍是多种妊娠并发症的核心因素。作为胎盘的功能单位,合体滋养层(STB)需持续融合前体滋养细胞并获得充足能量供应。本研究通过感染Ifnar1−/−妊娠小鼠建立不良妊娠模型。研究未检测到病毒在胎盘滋养层内复制,但观察到STB结构严重受损。RNA测序分析显示,前体滋养细胞的葡萄糖代谢受扰乱,胎盘组织上调促融合基因,但无法完成合胞体形成。代谢检测显示ATP水平降低、乳酸浓度升高,提示能量供应不足阻碍滋养细胞分化。体内使用糖酵解抑制剂2-DG可恢复胎盘氧化磷酸化(OXPHOS)活性,并显著改善病理结局。进一步机制研究证实,DENV感染诱导氧化应激,激活缺氧诱导因子Hif1α,进而上调乳酸脱氢酶(LDHA)表达。研究识别出该级联反应是滋养细胞代谢重编程的核心机制。本研究不仅阐明了驱动DENV诱导不良妊娠结局的关键病理过程,还提出了新的临床干预治疗策略。重要性 妊娠期登革热感染与不良胎儿结局相关,但其潜在机制尚不清楚。在Ifnar1−/−妊娠小鼠中,研究显示胎儿生长受限由破坏母体环境并损害胎盘功能所驱动。研究识别出合体滋养层损伤及前体滋养细胞融合缺陷,尽管存在促融合基因的代偿性上调。胎盘代谢分析显示线粒体氧化磷酸化向糖酵解转变,伴随ATP生成减少及合胞体形成受损。体内抑制糖酵解可部分恢复胎盘结构并改善胎儿结局,支持代谢重编程在其中的关键作用。从机制上看,活性氧(ROS)激活HIF-1α并上调其下游靶标LDHA,从而将代谢重编程与胎盘功能障碍联系起来,并凸显该通路为潜在治疗靶点。本研究揭示了登革病毒相关妊娠并发症的发生机制,并将代谢通路作为潜在治疗靶点。

papers.title: Plasma-derived extracellular vesicle microRNA as a potential biomarker associated with disease progression in non-severe dengue infection
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue can manifest as a mild febrile illness to life-threatening haemorrhagic fever. The early identification of patients at risk of disease progression remains challenging, particularly in non-severe cases. Therefore, this study aims to investigate the capability of extracellular vesicle plasma microRNA (miRNA) expression as a biomarker in dengue infection. METHODOLOGY: A total of 52 dengue patients (26 dengue with warning signs and 26 dengue without warning signs) were enrolled. Microarray analysis was utilised to profile miRNA derived from plasma extracellular vesicles to identify potential biomarkers associated with disease progression. Target genes were predicted bioinformatically to construct a miRNA-mRNA interaction network and identify key hub genes. The expression levels of miRNAs were validated through quantitative reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), and their diagnostic efficacy was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis. Additional functional enrichment analysis, gene ontology, and co-expression studies were conducted. An in vitro experiment using THP-1 cells investigated how hsa-miR-107 regulates P2RY12 expression, with further validation of P2RY12 levels through RT-qPCR using GAPDH as a reference. RESULTS: Microarray profiling identified 24 upregulated miRNAs in dengue patients with warning signs, notably hsa-miR-107 and hsa-miR-6879-5p, which were selected as potential biomarkers. Correlation analysis revealed that platelet count exhibited a statistically significant, moderate positive correlation with the hsa-miR-107 expression value. ROC analysis demonstrated strong diagnostic performance, linking these miRNAs to the platelet dysfunction and altered vascular permeability associated with disease severity. Furthermore, functional analysis supported the involvement of these pathways in dengue pathogenesis, and in vitro transfection confirmed that hsa-miR-107 actively decreases P2RY12 expression. CONCLUSION: This study highlights the expression of hsa-miR-107 and hsa-miR-6879-5p as candidate biomarkers associated with clinical warning signs in dengue infection. These findings could pave the way for improved diagnostic and monitoring strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the potential of plasma-derived extracellular vesicle microRNA (miRNA) expression as a biomarker for disease progression in non-severe dengue infection. The research aims to address the challenge of early identification of patients at risk of severe dengue, as non-severe cases often lack clear indicators of progression. A total of 52 dengue patients were enrolled, with 26 exhibiting warning signs and 26 without. The study employed microarray analysis to profile miRNAs from plasma extracellular vesicles, followed by RT-qPCR validation and ROC curve analysis to assess diagnostic efficacy. Results showed that hsa-miR-107 and hsa-miR-6879-5p were upregulated in patients with warning signs, with hsa-miR-107 correlating with platelet count and demonstrating strong diagnostic performance. Functional analysis supported their involvement in dengue pathogenesis, and in vitro experiments confirmed their regulatory role on P2RY12 expression. The authors suggest that these miRNAs could serve as candidate biomarkers for improved diagnostic and monitoring strategies in dengue infection. The study provides moderate evidence for their potential utility, though it does not report limitations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热可表现为轻度发热疾病至威胁生命的出血热。早期识别有疾病进展风险的患者仍具有挑战性,尤其是在非重症病例中。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 共纳入52名登革热患者(其中26名伴有警示征象的登革热患者和26名无警示征象的登革热患者)。研究采用微阵列分析技术对血浆外泌体来源的miRNA进行表征,以识别与疾病进展相关的潜在生物标志物。
elements_zh.methods: 微阵列分析鉴定出24个在登革热警示征兆患者中上调的miRNA,其中显著的有hsa-miR-107和hsa-miR-6879-5p,被选为潜在生物标志物。miRNA的表达水平通过实时荧光定量逆转录聚合酶链反应(RT-qPCR)进行验证,并采用受试者工作特征(ROC)曲线分析评估其诊断效能。使用THP-1细胞的体外实验探究了hsa-miR-107对P2RY12表达的调控作用,并通过以GAPDH为参考的RT-qPCR进一步验证了P2RY12水平。
elements_zh.main_results: 相关性分析显示,血小板计数与hsa-miR-107表达值呈现统计学显著的中等程度正相关。ROC分析表明这些miRNA与血小板功能障碍及与疾病严重程度相关的血管通透性改变具有较强的诊断性能。此外,功能分析支持这些通路参与登革发病机制的发病机制,且体外转染实验证实hsa-miR-107可主动降低P2RY12的表达。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究强调了hsa-miR-107和hsa-miR-6879-5p作为与登革热感染临床预警体征相关的候选生物标志物的表达。这些发现有望为改进诊断和监测策略铺平道路。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究深入探讨了登革病毒发病机制的分子机制,为未来疾病进展与治疗靶点的相关研究提供参考。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告局限性。该研究展示了较强的诊断性能,并为登革病毒发病机制提供了分子层面的见解,表明这些miRNA作为生物标志物潜在应用的证据水平为中等。

papers.title_zh: 来源于血浆外泌体的微小RNA作为非重症登革热感染疾病进展的潜在生物标志物
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue can manifest as a mild febrile illness to life-threatening haemorrhagic fever. The early identification of patients at risk of disease progression remains challenging, particularly in non-severe cases. Therefore, this study aims to investigate the capability of extracellular vesicle plasma microRNA (miRNA) expression as a biomarker in dengue infection. METHODOLOGY: A total of 52 dengue patients (26 dengue with warning signs and 26 dengue without warning signs) were enrolled. Microarray analysis was utilised to profile miRNA derived from plasma extracellular vesicles to identify potential biomarkers associated with disease progression. Target genes were predicted bioinformatically to construct a miRNA-mRNA interaction network and identify key hub genes. The expression levels of miRNAs were validated through quantitative reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), and their diagnostic efficacy was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis. Additional functional enrichment analysis, gene ontology, and co-expression studies were conducted. An in vitro experiment using THP-1 cells investigated how hsa-miR-107 regulates P2RY12 expression, with further validation of P2RY12 levels through RT-qPCR using GAPDH as a reference. RESULTS: Microarray profiling identified 24 upregulated miRNAs in dengue patients with warning signs, notably hsa-miR-107 and hsa-miR-6879-5p, which were selected as potential biomarkers. Correlation analysis revealed that platelet count exhibited a statistically significant, moderate positive correlation with the hsa-miR-107 expression value. ROC analysis demonstrated strong diagnostic performance, linking these miRNAs to the platelet dysfunction and altered vascular permeability associated with disease severity. Furthermore, functional analysis supported the involvement of these pathways in dengue pathogenesis, and in vitro transfection confirmed that hsa-miR-107 actively decreases P2RY12 expression. CONCLUSION: This study highlights the expression of hsa-miR-107 and hsa-miR-6879-5p as candidate biomarkers associated with clinical warning signs in dengue infection. These findings could pave the way for improved diagnostic and monitoring strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:登革热可表现为轻度发热性疾病到危及生命的出血热。在非重症病例中,早期识别有疾病进展风险的患者仍然具有挑战性。因此,本研究旨在探讨血浆外泌体微小RNA(miRNA)表达作为登革热感染生物标志物的能力。方法:共纳入52名登革热患者(26名有预警症状的登革热患者和26名无预警症状的登革热患者)。利用微阵列分析对来源于血浆外泌体的miRNA进行谱型分析,以识别与疾病进展相关的潜在生物标志物。通过生物信息学预测目标基因,构建miRNA-mRNA相互作用网络并识别关键枢纽基因。通过定量逆转录聚合酶链反应(RT-qPCR)验证miRNA的表达水平,并利用接收者操作特征(ROC)曲线分析评估其诊断效能。还进行了额外的功能富集分析、基因本体(GO)分析和共表达研究。使用THP-1细胞进行体外实验,研究hsa-miR-107如何调控P2RY12表达,并通过RT-qPCR进一步验证P2RY12水平,以GAPDH为参考。结果:微阵列谱型分析显示,在有预警症状的登革热患者中,有24种上调的miRNA,其中显著的包括hsa-miR-107和hsa-miR-6879-5p,被选为潜在生物标志物。相关性分析显示,血小板计数与hsa-miR-107表达值之间存在统计学上显著的中度正相关。ROC分析显示这些miRNA具有强大的诊断性能,将其与疾病严重程度相关的血小板功能障碍和血管通透性改变联系起来。此外,功能分析支持这些通路在登革热发病机制中的参与,体外转染实验确认hsa-miR-107能够主动降低P2RY12的表达。结论:本研究突出了hsa-miR-107和hsa-miR-6879-5p的表达作为与登革热感染临床预警症状相关的候选生物标志物。这些发现可能为改进诊断和监测策略铺平道路。科学与公共卫生意义:该研究提供了关于登革热发病机制分子机制的见解,这可能有助于未来对疾病进展和治疗靶点的研究。局限性与证据强度:提供的证据未报告局限性。该研究展示了强大的诊断性能,并提供了登革热发病机制的分子见解,表明这些miRNA作为生物标志物的潜在应用具有中等证据强度。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热可表现为轻度发热疾病至威胁生命的出血热。早期识别有疾病进展风险的患者仍具有挑战性,尤其是在非重症病例中。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 共纳入52名登革热患者(其中26名伴有警示征象的登革热患者和26名无警示征象的登革热患者)。研究采用微阵列分析技术对血浆外泌体来源的miRNA进行表征,以识别与疾病进展相关的潜在生物标志物。
analysis_zh.methods: 微阵列分析鉴定出24个在登革热警示征兆患者中上调的miRNA,其中显著的有hsa-miR-107和hsa-miR-6879-5p,被选为潜在生物标志物。miRNA的表达水平通过实时荧光定量逆转录聚合酶链反应(RT-qPCR)进行验证,并采用受试者工作特征(ROC)曲线分析评估其诊断效能。使用THP-1细胞的体外实验探究了hsa-miR-107对P2RY12表达的调控作用,并通过以GAPDH为参考的RT-qPCR进一步验证了P2RY12水平。
analysis_zh.main_results: 相关性分析显示,血小板计数与hsa-miR-107表达值呈现统计学显著的中等程度正相关。ROC分析表明这些miRNA与血小板功能障碍及与疾病严重程度相关的血管通透性改变具有较强的诊断性能。此外,功能分析支持这些通路参与登革发病机制的发病机制,且体外转染实验证实hsa-miR-107可主动降低P2RY12的表达。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究强调了hsa-miR-107和hsa-miR-6879-5p作为与登革热感染临床预警体征相关的候选生物标志物的表达。这些发现有望为改进诊断和监测策略铺平道路。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究深入探讨了登革病毒发病机制的分子机制,为未来疾病进展与治疗靶点的相关研究提供参考。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告局限性。该研究展示了较强的诊断性能,并为登革病毒发病机制提供了分子层面的见解,表明这些miRNA作为生物标志物潜在应用的证据水平为中等。

papers.title: Tactical vs. strategic: An adaptable framework for horizon-dependent dengue forecasting using data-driven approaches with serotype and climate covariates in Bangladesh
papers.abstract: Dengue remains a major public health problem in endemic regions, including Bangladesh. Forecasting algorithms relying on climatic variables may not capture epidemiological information such as dengue serotype patterns. This study proposes a horizon-dependent dengue forecasting framework and applies it to Bangladesh. This pipeline included temporal, meteorological, demographic, and epidemiological covariates in a district-panel pipeline and compares classical, machine-learning, and deep-learning algorithms using aggregate, horizon-wise, regime-wise, outbreak-detection, and uncertainty metrics. Coefficient-based interpretation, SHAP, permutation importance, and nonlinear causal-dependence analysis were used to examine predictor impacts across horizons. SARIMAX was used as the baseline model. TFT produced quantile forecasts but showed poor interval calibration during outbreak periods. Results show that no single model performed best across all forecasting horizons: SARIMAX ranked highest for one-step outbreak alerting (precision = 0.886, recall = 0.824, F1 score = 0.854, and ROC-AUC = 0.950), whereas Prophet performed best for pooled magnitude forecasting at horizons 2–6. MLR showed competitive performance in regime-wise evaluation. These findings show that dengue forecasting algorithms should be selected according to the intended decision objective and evaluated using task-relevant protocols.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the need for improved dengue forecasting in Bangladesh, where dengue remains a significant public health issue. The research introduces a horizon-dependent framework that integrates serotype and climate data to enhance forecasting accuracy. The study design involves a district-panel pipeline incorporating temporal, meteorological, demographic, and epidemiological covariates, comparing classical, machine-learning, and deep-learning algorithms. The methods include coefficient-based interpretation, SHAP, permutation importance, and nonlinear causal-dependence analysis. The main results indicate that no single model outperformed others across all forecasting horizons, with SARIMAX excelling in one-step outbreak alerting and Prophet in pooled magnitude forecasting. papers.title: Climate and dengue synchronization in southern Brazil: a municipal analysis with cross-state validation
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue transmission is rapidly expanding beyond its historical tropical range, raising concerns about how climate change may alter the collective dynamics of epidemics. While most studies focus on transmission risk, much less is known about how climate affects the synchronization of outbreaks. In this work, we investigate dengue synchronization using epidemiological and climate data from 74 municipalities in the state of Paraná (southern Brazil) between 2010 and 2024. We quantify outbreak coherence using the event synchronization (ES) method. Our results reveal a transition from a low-transmission regime to a high-transmission regime accompanied by a marked increase in synchronization across cities. We also show that climate anomalies increase the number of permissive days for dengue transmission. Our results suggest that such days are significantly associated with outbreak synchronization. We identify a two-stage climate mechanism: conducive climatic conditions first reduce the probability of asynchronous states and coincide with the emergence of synchronized outbreaks, and subsequently sustain higher synchronization levels. Extending the analysis through comparative analyses in Ceará and Minas Gerais, we uncover that climate consistently amplifies synchronization, although its role in the onset of synchronization depends on regional climatic regimes. These findings highlight climate-driven synchronization as an emerging feature shaping dengue dynamics.
papers.journal: Journal of the Royal Society Interface

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究利用巴西南部巴拉那州(PR)2010—2024年间74个市级单位的流行病学与气候数据,采用事件同步化(ES)方法量化登革热同步化程度。通过在塞阿腊州与米纳斯吉拉斯州开展对比分析,研究发现气候始终放大同步化效应,尽管其在同步化起始阶段的作用依赖于区域气候模式。
elements_zh.methods: 研究采用事件同步化(ES)方法量化登革热同步化程度。研究识别出一个二阶段气候机制:有利的气候条件首先降低异步状态的概率,并与同步化登革热流行的出现同时发生,随后维持更高的同步化水平。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究结果揭示了从低风险登革热流行模式向高风险登革热流行模式的转变,并伴随城市间同步化程度的显著提升。研究还表明,气候异常可增加登革热流行的许可日数量。结果提示此类许可日与登革热同步化显著相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果凸显了气候驱动的同步化作为塑造登革热动态的新兴特征。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果提示气候异常可用于预测与监测登革热同步化,为登革热监测与干预策略提供科学依据。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供证据未报告研究局限性。证据强度较高,因研究采用了综合数据集与稳健分析方法量化登革热同步化程度并识别气候机制。

papers.title: Fetal-derived PF4+ tissue-resident macrophages recruit neutrophils as a key mechanism underlying DENV-2-induced intrauterine growth restriction in mice
papers.abstract: Extensive clinical cases and epidemiological analyses have indicated that symptomatic dengue virus (DENV) infection may lead to adverse outcomes during pregnancy; however, the precise mechanisms remain elusive. In our previous work, we demonstrated that DENV-2 infection induces intrauterine growth restriction by triggering neutrophil-mediated destruction of the placental vascular system in mice. However, the specific mechanisms driving neutrophil infiltration into the placenta remain unclear, especially given that the placenta constitutes a unique immune-privileged niche dedicated to maintaining maternal–fetal tolerance. In this study, we generated a time-resolved single-cell atlas of placentas from interferon-alpha/beta receptor-deficient mice infected with DENV-2. Integrated analysis of single-cell transcriptomes and single-nucleotide polymorphism sequencing revealed that infection primarily activated fetal-origin tissue-resident PF4 + macrophages. Activated fetal macrophages mediate preferential recruitment and the subsequent aberrant accumulation of neutrophils in the labyrinth zone through the secretion of CXCL2, which binds to neutrophil CXCR2. Notably, the recruited neutrophils further exhibited an enhanced self-recruitment phenotype. Blocking CXCL2-CXCR2 signaling effectively inhibited neutrophil recruitment, restored placental microvascular density, and alleviated fetal intrauterine growth restriction. This study revealed that the activation of placental tissue-resident macrophages is responsible for the aberrant neutrophil infiltration in the placenta following DENV-2 infection. Mechanistically, macrophages initiate the recruitment of self-amplifying neutrophils, and the CXCL2-CXCR2 signaling pathway plays a crucial role in this process. These results provide important information for the clinical development of therapeutic strategies against DENV-2-induced adverse pregnancy outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the mechanisms by which DENV-2 infection causes intrauterine growth restriction in mice. The research highlights that DENV-2 infection activates fetal-derived PF4+ tissue-resident macrophages, which recruit neutrophils through CXCL2-CXCR2 signaling. The findings suggest that targeting this pathway could offer therapeutic strategies for DENV-2-induced adverse pregnancy outcomes. The study uses a time-resolved single-cell atlas and integrated transcriptomic and genetic analyses to uncover these mechanisms. While the results are significant for understanding DENV-2's impact on pregnancy, the evidence does not explicitly report limitations, which may affect the confidence in the conclusions.

papers.abstract_zh: 大量临床病例与流行病学分析表明,有症状的登革病毒(DENV)感染可能导致妊娠期不良结局;然而,其确切机制仍未明确。在先前的研究中,我们证明DENV-2感染通过触发中性粒细胞介导的胎盘血管系统破坏,在小鼠中诱导宫内发育迟缓。然而,驱动中性粒细胞向胎盘浸润的具体机制仍不清楚,尤其是考虑到胎盘构成一个独特的免疫豁免微环境,专用于维持母胎耐受。在本研究中,我们构建了干扰素-α/β受体缺陷小鼠感染DENV-2后胎盘的时间分辨单细胞图谱。通过整合单细胞转录组与单核苷酸多态性测序分析,揭示感染主要激活了胎源性组织驻留PF4+巨噬细胞。激活的胎源性巨噬细胞通过分泌结合中性粒细胞CXCR2的CXCL2,介导中性粒细胞优先向胎盘血管区域浸润并随后异常积聚。值得注意的是,招募的中性粒细胞进一步表现出增强的自我招募表型。阻断CXCL2-CXCR2信号通路可有效抑制中性粒细胞招募、恢复胎盘微血管密度并缓解胎儿宫内发育迟缓。本研究揭示了胎盘组织驻留巨噬细胞的激活是DENV-2感染后胎盘异常中性粒细胞浸润的责任细胞。从机制上看,巨噬细胞启动自我放大的中性粒细胞招募,而CXCL2-CXCR2信号通路在此过程中发挥关键作用。这些结果为针对DENV-2诱导的不良妊娠结局的临床治疗策略开发提供了重要信息。

papers.full_text: Abstract Dengue infection is a mosquito-borne disease that can cause mild illness or severe haemorrhagic fever. Predictive biomarkers for severe cases, especially those with bleeding manifestations or plasma leakage, are currently lacking. This systematic review and meta-analysis synthesises findings from studies on circulating miRNAs in dengue infection, sourced from PubMed, Scopus, Science Direct, and Web of Science, with quality assessed by the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale (PROSPERO: CRD42024521685). Quantitative meta-analyses were conducted using RStudio to evaluate diagnostic Area Under the Curve (AUC) metrics across five eligible studies and Standardised Mean Differences (SMD) for differential miRNA expression. Key miRNAs, such as miR-146a, miR-150, miR-378, miR-21-5p, and miR-1246, were found to regulate immune responses, inflammation, and viral replication. Meta-analysis demonstrated high overall diagnostic accuracy for circulating miRNAs, with individual reported AUC values ranging from 0.79 to 1.00; however, substantial statistical heterogeneity was observed across pooled metrics (I-squared exceeding 89%). SMD analysis highlighted significant upregulation of acute inflammatory drivers, including miR-21-5p (SMD = 4.67) and miR-450b-5p (SMD = 6.76), alongside marked downregulation of endothelial-protective markers such as miR-126-3p (SMD = -1.31). Rather than viewing dysregulated microRNAs as a uniform class of clinical tools, this review highlights that candidate microRNAs span distinct translational tiers. Recognising these validation levels alongside pre-analytical and biological heterogeneity is essential for prioritising the most viable microRNA candidates for future prospective clinical translation and targeted therapies in dengue management. Data availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract Dengue infection is a mosquito-borne disease that can cause mild illness or severe haemorrhagic fever. Predictive biomarkers for severe cases, especially those with bleeding manifestations or plasma leakage, are currently lacking. This systematic review and meta-analysis synthesises findings from studies on circulating miRNAs in dengue infection, sourced from PubMed, Scopus, Science Direct, and Web of Science, with quality assessed by the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale (PROSPERO: CRD42024521685). Quantitative meta-analyses were conducted using RStudio to evaluate diagnostic Area Under the Curve (AUC) metrics across five eligible studies and Standardised Mean Differences (SMD) for differential miRNA expression. Key miRNAs, such as miR-146a, miR-150, miR-378, miR-21-5p, and miR-1246, were found to regulate immune responses, inflammation, and viral replication. Meta-analysis demonstrated high overall diagnostic accuracy for circulating miRNAs, with individual reported AUC values ranging from 0.79 to 1.00; however, substantial statistical heterogeneity was observed across pooled metrics (I-squared exceeding 89%). SMD analysis highlighted significant upregulation of acute inflammatory drivers, including miR-21-5p (SMD = 4.67) and miR-450b-5p (SMD = 6.76), alongside marked downregulation of endothelial-protective markers such as miR-126-3p (SMD = -1.31). Rather than viewing dysregulated microRNAs as a uniform class of clinical tools, this review highlights that candidate microRNAs span distinct translational tiers. Recognising these validation levels alongside pre-analytical and biological heterogeneity is essential for prioritising the most viable microRNA candidates for future prospective clinical translation and targeted therapies in dengue management. Data availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. papers.title_original: Systematic review and meta-analysis of circulating microRNAs in dengue infection: biomarkers, pathogenesis, and clinical implications

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on dengue virus and its associated disease, examining circulating microRNAs (miRNAs) as potential biomarkers for predicting severe cases, such as dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) and dengue shock syndrome (DSS). The central question is whether miRNAs can serve as reliable indicators of disease severity and progression.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic synthesis of findings from five eligible studies, sourced from PubMed, Scopus, Science Direct, and Web of Science. The quality of these studies was assessed using the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale. Quantitative meta-analyses were conducted using RStudio to evaluate diagnostic Area Under the Curve (AUC) metrics and Standardised Mean Differences (SMD) for differential miRNA expression.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Key miRNAs such as miR-146a, miR-150, miR-378, miR-21-5p, and miR-1246 were identified as regulators of immune responses, inflammation, and viral replication. The meta-analysis showed high diagnostic accuracy for circulating miRNAs, with AUC values ranging from 0.79 to 1.00, although substantial statistical heterogeneity was observed (I-squared exceeding 89%).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that while miRNAs show promise as biomarkers, their dysregulation is not a uniform class of clinical tools. Instead, candidate miRNAs span distinct translational tiers. Additionally, the review highlights the need to consider pre-analytical and biological heterogeneity when prioritizing miRNA candidates for clinical translation.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should focus on validating the most viable miRNA candidates for clinical use, particularly in the context of severe dengue. It also emphasizes the importance of addressing biological and pre-analytical variability to improve the reliability of miRNA-based diagnostics.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis explores the role of circulating microRNAs (miRNAs) in dengue infection, focusing on their potential as biomarkers for predicting severe disease outcomes such as dengue hemorrhagic fever and dengue shock syndrome. The review synthesises findings from five studies, using meta-analytic methods to evaluate diagnostic accuracy and differential miRNA expression. Key miRNAs, including miR-146a, miR-150, miR-378, miR-21-5p, and miR-1246, were found to regulate immune responses, inflammation, and viral replication. While the meta-analysis demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy for miRNAs, substantial heterogeneity was observed. The review highlights the need to consider biological and pre-analytical variability when prioritising miRNA candidates for clinical translation and future targeted therapies.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于登革病毒及其相关疾病,探讨循环微小RNA(miRNA)作为预测重症病例(如登革出血热与登革休克综合征)生物标志物的潜力。核心问题是miRNA是否可作为疾病严重程度与进展的可靠指标。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述为五项符合条件研究的系统性综合,数据来源包括PubMed、Scopus、Science Direct及Web of Science。研究质量采用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表评估。使用RStudio进行定量荟萃分析,评估诊断曲线下面积(AUC)指标及差异miRNA表达的标准化均数差(SMD)。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 确定了miR-146a、miR-150、miR-378、miR-21-5p及miR-1246等关键miRNA,其可调控免疫应答、炎症及病毒复制。荟萃分析显示循环miRNA具有高诊断准确性,AUC值范围为0.79至1.00,但存在显著统计异质性(I平方值超过89%)。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,尽管miRNA在生物标志物方面显示出潜力,但其失调并非一类统一的临床工具。候选miRNA跨越不同的转化层级。此外,综述强调在优先考虑miRNA候选物用于临床转化时,需关注预分析与生物学异质性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议未来研究应重点验证最具可行性的miRNA候选物用于临床,特别是在重症登革热背景下。同时强调需解决生物学与预分析变异性,以提高基于miRNA诊断的可靠性。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于登革病毒及其相关疾病,探讨循环微小RNA(miRNA)作为预测重症病例(如登革出血热与登革休克综合征)生物标志物的潜力。核心问题是miRNA是否可作为疾病严重程度与进展的可靠指标。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述为五项符合条件研究的系统性综合,数据来源包括PubMed、Scopus、Science Direct及Web of Science。研究质量采用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表评估。使用RStudio进行定量荟萃分析,评估诊断曲线下面积(AUC)指标及差异miRNA表达的标准化均数差(SMD)。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 确定了miR-146a、miR-150、miR-378、miR-21-5p及miR-1246等关键miRNA,其可调控免疫应答、炎症及病毒复制。荟萃分析显示循环miRNA具有高诊断准确性,AUC值范围为0.79至1.00,但存在显著统计异质性(I平方值超过89%)。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,尽管miRNA在生物标志物方面显示出潜力,但其失调并非一类统一的临床工具。候选miRNA跨越不同的转化层级。此外,综述强调在优先考虑miRNA候选物用于临床转化时,需关注预分析与生物学异质性。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议未来研究应重点验证最具可行性的miRNA候选物用于临床,特别是在重症登革热背景下。同时强调需解决生物学与预分析变异性,以提高基于miRNA诊断的可靠性。

papers.title: Dengue Vaccines in a Changing Epidemiological Landscape: Current Evidence, Unresolved Challenges, and Public Health Considerations
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue has expanded rapidly beyond traditional tropical and subtropical regions, driven by climate change, urbanization, population mobility, and the spread of competent Aedes vectors. Vaccination is an increasingly important component of dengue prevention, but development has been complicated by four viral serotypes, antibody-dependent enhancement, variable baseline serostatus, and the need for balanced and durable tetravalent immunity. Methods: We conducted a narrative review of PubMed/MEDLINE, Google Scholar, ClinicalTrials.gov, and relevant public health and regulatory sources. Evidence on dengue epidemiology, immunopathogenesis, licensed vaccines, advanced candidates, efficacy, immunogenicity, safety, durability, and implementation was critically evaluated. Priority was given to randomized trials, long-term follow-up studies, regulatory assessments, and surveillance data. Evidence was synthesized descriptively without formal meta-analysis or risk-of-bias assessment. Results: CYD-TDV was the first licensed dengue vaccine but is restricted to individuals with documented previous infection because seronegative recipients may experience an increased risk of severe dengue. TAK-003 has demonstrated overall efficacy against virologically confirmed dengue and dengue-related hospitalization in both baseline-seropositive and baseline-seronegative populations. However, protection is heterogeneous by serotype, and evidence remains limited or uncertain for some serotype-by-serostatus strata. Butantan-DV offers a promising single-dose strategy, but broader use requires additional long-term safety, effectiveness, and serotype-specific data. Inactivated, DNA, viral-vectored, virus-like particle, and mRNA vaccines remain investigational. Conclusions: Dengue vaccination should be integrated with surveillance, vector control, clinical preparedness, and risk communication. Population-based vaccination is most appropriate in high-transmission settings, whereas selective, risk-based strategies are preferable in temperate regions. Continued pharmacovigilance and effectiveness monitoring are essential to guide safe and equitable implementation.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the role of dengue vaccines in a changing epidemiological landscape. It highlights the challenges posed by the four dengue serotypes, antibody-dependent enhancement, and variable baseline serostatus. The review synthesizes evidence from narrative evaluations of PubMed/MEDLINE, Google Scholar, ClinicalTrials.gov, and public health sources. Key findings include the restricted use of CYD-TDV for seropositive individuals, the efficacy of TAK-003 across serostatus groups, and the potential of Butantan-DV as a single-dose strategy. However, evidence gaps persist, particularly in serotype-specific protection and long-term safety. The review concludes that dengue vaccination should be integrated with surveillance, vector control, and risk communication. It emphasizes the need for continued monitoring and the importance of population-based strategies in high-transmission areas.

papers.title: Mechanical drivers of dengue virus-induced endothelial dysfunction
papers.abstract: More than one billion individuals worldwide are at risk of contracting dengue. Dengue virus (DENV) is a ssRNA(+)-flavivirus transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. While most infections are mild (uncomplicated dengue), severe/hemorrhagic dengue carries substantial mortality and lacks specific treatment. Severe dengue is characterized by endothelial dysfunction, which can arise during both primary and secondary infection. In the latter, antibody-dependent enhancement of infection is a well-recognized risk factor, although the mechanistic links between viral infection and endothelial barrier failure remain unclear in either setting. Beyond inflammatory injury to the endothelium, DENV and other flaviviruses can trigger endothelial trans-differentiation toward a mesenchymal, migratory phenotype, weakening cell–cell junctions and compromising vascular integrity. In this review, we discuss the mechanical component of flavivirus-induced endothelial trans-differentiation and its impact on endothelial dysfunction, highlighting prospective mechanobiological targets for therapeutic intervention.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the mechanical drivers of dengue virus-induced endothelial dysfunction, specifically examining how dengue viruses 1–4 contribute to endothelial trans-differentiation and vascular integrity compromise. The central question is how mechanical forces influence endothelial barrier failure in dengue disease.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of existing literature on dengue virus and its effects on endothelial cells. It does not report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates but discusses the biological mechanisms and implications of dengue-induced endothelial dysfunction. The review includes general background information on dengue virus and its transmission, as well as its association with severe disease.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that endothelial dysfunction is a key feature of severe dengue, and that antibody-dependent enhancement during secondary infection is a well-recognized risk factor. It highlights that while the inflammatory injury to the endothelium is a known mechanism, the precise mechanistic links between viral infection and endothelial barrier failure remain unclear. Additionally, it notes that DENV and other flaviviruses can trigger endothelial trans-differentiation toward a mesenchymal, migratory phenotype, which weakens cell–cell junctions and compromises vascular integrity.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies a lack of clarity regarding the mechanistic links between viral infection and endothelial barrier failure in both primary and secondary infections. It also points out that while endothelial trans-differentiation is a proposed mechanism, the evidence supporting this is not fully established. The review acknowledges that beyond inflammatory injury, other mechanical factors may contribute to endothelial dysfunction, but these are not yet well characterized.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that understanding the mechanical drivers of dengue virus-induced endothelial dysfunction could lead to the identification of prospective mechanobiological targets for therapeutic intervention. It emphasizes the need for further research to clarify the mechanisms underlying endothelial barrier failure and to explore potential strategies for preventing or treating severe dengue.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the mechanical drivers of dengue virus-induced endothelial dysfunction, focusing on how dengue viruses 1–4 contribute to vascular integrity compromise. It highlights that severe dengue is characterized by endothelial dysfunction, which can occur during both primary and secondary infections. While antibody-dependent enhancement is a known risk factor for secondary infections, the precise mechanisms linking viral infection to endothelial barrier failure remain unclear. The review also notes that DENV and other flaviviruses may trigger endothelial trans-differentiation toward a mesenchymal phenotype, weakening cell–cell junctions. These findings suggest that targeting mechanobiological pathways could offer new therapeutic strategies for severe dengue. However, the review identifies gaps in understanding the specific mechanical processes involved and calls for further research to clarify these mechanisms.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于登革病毒诱导的内皮功能障碍的机械驱动因素,重点探讨登革病毒 1–4如何促进内皮细胞横向分化及血管完整性受损。核心问题是机械力如何影响登革热疾病中的内皮屏障功能衰竭。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述为既往文献中关于登革病毒及其对内皮细胞影响的叙事性综合。未进行荟萃分析或汇总估计,但讨论了登革病毒诱导内皮功能障碍的生物学机制及其意义。综述包含登革病毒的背景信息及其传播,以及其与重症的关联。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论:内皮功能障碍是重症登革热的关键特征,且在继发感染期间的抗体依赖性增强是一项公认的重症风险因素。综述强调,尽管内皮的炎症性损伤是已知机制,但病毒感染与内皮屏障功能衰竭之间的确切机制性关联仍不清楚。此外,综述指出登革病毒(DENV)及其他黄病毒可触发内皮细胞向间充质、迁移表型横向分化,从而削弱细胞间连接并损害血管完整性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,在原发及继发感染中,病毒感染与内皮屏障功能衰竭之间的机制性关联仍存在不明确之处。同时指出,尽管内皮横向分化被提出为一种机制,但支持该机制的证据尚未完全确立。综述承认,除炎症性损伤外,其他机械因素可能参与内皮功能障碍,但这些因素尚未得到充分表征。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议,理解登革病毒诱导内皮功能障碍的机械驱动因素,或可助力识别前瞻性机械生物学治疗靶标。综述强调需进一步研究以明确内皮屏障功能衰竭的机制,并探索预防或治疗重症登革热的潜在策略。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study examines why climate change is driving surges in dengue and other mosquito-borne diseases, identifying a critical knowledge gap in understanding how climatic and socioeconomic factors interact to alter dengue transmission dynamics.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The paper is a narrative review synthesizing evidence on climate change impacts on dengue, drawing on global studies and meta-analyses to assess transmission patterns and risk factors.
analysis.methods: The review employs a meta-analysis approach to evaluate temperature impacts on dengue incidence, integrating climatic and socioeconomic mediators to model nonlinear relationships.
analysis.main_results: The review reports that climate warming is expanding the dengue burden in the Americas and Asia, with temperature effects on dengue incidence being nonlinear and mediated by climatic and socioeconomic factors.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as evidence that climate change is reshaping dengue epidemiology through complex interactions, highlighting the need for integrated climate-resilient strategies to mitigate transmission.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the urgency of strengthening vector control, surveillance, and climate-informed disease burden projections to build dengue resilience in a changing climate.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The review relies on synthesized evidence rather than primary data, limiting causal inference and generalisability; the strength of evidence is moderate due to heterogeneity in included studies and potential confounding.

analysis.summary_en: This narrative review evaluates how climate change is driving surges in dengue and other mosquito-borne diseases by synthesizing global evidence on climatic and socioeconomic drivers. The authors use a meta-analysis to demonstrate that temperature impacts on dengue incidence are nonlinear and mediated by climatic and socioeconomic factors, with climate warming expanding dengue burden in the Americas and Asia. They argue that strengthening vector control, surveillance, climate-informed projections, sustainable urban management, and community engagement is critical for building dengue resilience. The review highlights the need for cross-sectoral partnerships to create climate-resilient systems that improve health outcomes. However, the evidence strength is moderate due to reliance on synthesized data, heterogeneity in studies, and potential confounding, limiting causal conclusions.

papers.title: Ligand‐Based Virtual Screening Discovery of Thienopyrimidinone Derivatives as Allosteric nSMase2 Modulators and Antivirals Against West Nile Virus.
papers.abstract: Orthoflaviviruses such as West Nile virus (WNV), Zika virus (ZIKV), or dengue virus (DENV) represent a growing global health threat, with millions of annual infections and no approved antiviral therapies. Targeting host pathways represents an alternative antiviral strategy that may overcome limitations associated with direct-acting antivirals, including resistance and narrow antiviral spectra. Neutral sphingomyelinase-2 (nSMase2) plays a central role in sphingolipid metabolism and has emerged as a host factor involved in the replication of several flaviviruses including WNV and ZIKV. Herein, we report a new family of thienopyrimidinone derivatives as nSMase2 inhibitors. A ligand-based virtual screening (LBVS) campaign using DPTIP as a template ligand identified 13 candidates from over 5 million ZINC20 compounds, which were refined through ADMET-properties prediction and molecular docking. Experimental evaluation identified compound 16 as a novel nSMase2 inhibitor. Rational design guided by computational affinity maps enabled the synthesis of several derivatives bearing a thienopyrimidinone core. These compounds inhibited nSMase2 and showed antiviral activity against WNV in cell‐based assays. These results identify thienopyrimidinone derivatives as a new scaffold for nSMase2 inhibition and support host-directed modulation of sphingolipid metabolism as a promising strategy for the development of broad-spectrum antivirals against flaviviruses.

papers.source_body_en: Orthoflaviviruses such as West Nile virus (WNV), Zika virus (ZIKV), or dengue virus (DENV) represent a growing global health threat, with millions of annual infections and no approved antiviral therapies. Targeting host pathways represents an alternative antiviral strategy that may overcome limitations associated with direct-acting antivirals, including resistance and narrow antiviral spectra. Neutral sphingomyelinase-2 (nSMase2) plays a central role in sphingolipid metabolism and has emerged as a host factor involved in the replication of several flaviviruses including WNV and ZIKV. Herein, we report a new family of thienopyrimidinone derivatives as nSMase2 inhibitors. A ligand-based virtual screening (LBVS) campaign using DPTIP as a template ligand identified 13 candidates from over 5 million ZINC20 compounds, which were refined through ADMET-properties prediction and molecular docking. Experimental evaluation identified compound 16 as a novel nSMase2 inhibitor. Rational design guided by computational affinity maps enabled the synthesis of several derivatives bearing a thienopyrimidinone core. These compounds inhibited nSMase2 and showed antiviral activity against WNV in cell‐based assays. These results identify thienopyrimidinone derivatives as a new scaffold for nSMase2 inhibition and support host-directed modulation of sphingolipid metabolism as a promising strategy for the development of broad-spectrum antivirals against flaviviruses.
