papers.title: Safety and Preliminary Efficacy of Dengue Monoclonal Antibody in Adult Patients
papers.abstract: Importance Dengue outbreaks are increasing in frequency and intensity. In the absence of any specific treatment, a pan-serotype recombinant monoclonal antibody (Dengue-mAb) was tested in adult patients with dengue as a therapeutic option. Objective To assess the safety and effect of a single dose of Dengue-mAb on dengue viremia at different dose levels among patients with dengue. Design, Setting, and Participants A phase 2, single-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial was conducted from September 19, 2021, to May 13, 2023, at 12 hospitals in India. Study participants were aged 18 to 60 years with dengue and a history of fever onset within 48 hours. Key exclusion criteria were severe dengue, hemoglobin less than 10 g/dL, absolute neutrophil count less than 500/mm 3 , total leukocyte count less than 1500/mm 3 , platelet count less than 50 000/mm 3 , and any other clinically significant disorders. Data were analyzed from January 11, 2024, to March 26, 2024. Interventions Participants were randomly allocated 1:1:1:1:1 using an interactive web response system to receive 1 of 4 dose levels of Dengue-mAb (3, 5, 7, or 9 mg/kg) or placebo by slow intravenous infusion. Main Outcomes and Measures Primary outcomes were reduction in viremia at 24 hours and causally related serious adverse events (SAEs). Secondary outcomes were RNAemia, fever, and hematologic and pharmacokinetic parameters. Findings A total of 250 participants were randomized, with 50 participants in each group. The overall median age was 30 years (IQR, 24-37 years), and 180 participants (72.3%) were male. There were no causally related SAEs. The adjusted mean (SE) viral log reduction at 24 hours was significantly higher with Dengue-mAb—from 1.93 (0.23) with 3 mg/kg ( P = .04) to 2.35 (0.27) with 9 mg/kg ( P = .003)—compared with placebo (1.29 [0.22]), using a mixed model for repeated measures. Participants with detectable viremia (n = 32) at baseline were negative for dengue virus by 8 hours when treated with a 5- to 9-mg/kg dose of Dengue-mAb compared with 72 hours with placebo. Median time to fever clearance was 3.5 (95% CI, 1.0-24.0) hours (hazard ratio [HR], 2.6 [95% CI, 1.0-6.4]) with Dengue-mAb 5 mg/kg (n = 14) and 2.0 (95% CI, 0.5-6.0) hours (HR, 2.8 [95% CI, 1.2-6.8]) with Dengue-mAb 7 mg/kg (n = 14), compared with 26.8 (95% CI, 1.0-50.5) hours with placebo (n = 12). At 24 hours, between 13 of 14 participants (92.9%; 95% CI, 66.1%-99.8%) with Dengue-mAb (3 mg/kg), 14 of 14 participants (100.0%; 95% CI, 76.8%-100.0%) with Dengue-mAb (5 mg/kg and 7 mg/kg), and 16 of 17 participants (94.1%; 95% CI 71.3%-99.9%) with Dengue-mAb (9 mg/kg); and 7 of 12 participants (58.3%; 95% CI, 27.7%-84.8%) with placebo had fever clearance. Conclusions and Relevance In this randomized clinical trial, Dengue-mAb was safe and well tolerated. Dengue-mAb rapidly reduced dengue viremia and fever at doses of 5 mg/kg and 7 mg/kg, making this the first therapeutic against wild-type dengue virus to show preliminary efficacy in humans. Trial Registration Clinical Trial Registry-India Identifier: CTRI/2021/07/035290

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the safety and preliminary efficacy of a pan-serotype recombinant monoclonal antibody (Dengue-mAb) in adult patients with dengue. Conducted as a phase 2, single-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial in India, the study enrolled 250 participants aged 18 to 60 years with dengue and fever onset within 48 hours. Dengue-mAb was administered at four dose levels (3, 5, 7, or 9 mg/kg) or as a placebo. The primary outcomes were reduction in viremia at 24 hours and serious adverse events, while secondary outcomes included RNAemia, fever, and hematologic parameters. The study concluded that Dengue-mAb was safe and well tolerated, and it demonstrated preliminary efficacy in reducing dengue viremia and fever. The findings suggest potential therapeutic applications for dengue, but the study's moderate evidence strength is due to its limited sample size and lack of long-term follow-up.

papers.title: Transmission Dynamics and Optimal Control of Malaria-Dengue Co-infection: A Cost-Effectiveness Analysis
papers.abstract: This study presents a comprehensive deterministic compartmental model for malaria-dengue co-infection incorporating distinct vector populations (Anopheles for malaria and Aedes for dengue), disease-specific progression pathways, and co-infection compartments. The model is rigorously analyzed to establish positivity, boundedness, disease-free and endemic equilibria, and basic reproduction numbers. Optimal control theory is applied to evaluate six time-dependent intervention strategies: insecticide-treated bed nets (ITNs), indoor residual spraying (IRS), environmental management, personal protection measures, treatment compliance, and vaccination. Model parameters are estimated using Brazilian malaria and dengue case data (2011-2023). Sensitivity analysis identifies key parameters influencing disease transmission. Cost-effectiveness analysis using infection averted ratio (IAR), average cost-effectiveness ratio (ACER), and incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) reveals that the combined implementation of all six control measures (Strategy 9) is most cost-effective, averting 9,200 infections (35.38% reduction) at an ACER of 3,756.536. These findings provide crucial guidance for designing economically efficient intervention strategies in resource-constrained co-endemic settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在理解疟疾-登革热共感染的传播动态,并评估最优控制策略以减轻两种疾病的负担。研究目标是深入分析共感染的影响,并为制定成本效益干预措施提供指导。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究构建了一个确定性分隔模型,用于模拟疟疾-登革热共感染,该模型包含不同的媒介种群(疟疾媒介按蚊与登革热媒介伊蚊)及疾病特异性进展路径。模型分析基于巴西2011-2023年疟疾与登革热病例数据。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用最优控制理论评估六种时间依赖性干预策略:蚊帐(ITNs)、室内残留喷洒(IRS)、环境管理、个人防护措施、治疗依从性及疫苗接种。通过敏感性分析识别影响疾病传播的关键参数。
elements_zh.main_results: 成本效益分析显示,六种控制措施的联合实施(策略9)成本效益最高,可避免9,200例感染(减少35.38%),平均成本效益比(ACER)为3,756.536。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了整合多种干预策略以实现疟疾-登革热混合感染最佳控制的重要性,为设计经济高效的公共卫生干预措施提供了一种新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为在资源有限且疟疾与登革热共存的地区制定有针对性且成本效益的干预策略提供了关键指导,支持疾病控制的科学决策。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于确定性模型,并依赖历史数据,可能无法捕捉现实世界的变异性。由于分析仅基于摘要且存在未纳入的潜在偏倚,证据强度为中等。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal epidemiology of dengue fever across all 64 districts of Bangladesh: a retrospective ecological analysis of reported hospital admissions
papers.abstract: Bangladesh has experienced increasingly widespread dengue activity, with hospital admissions reported beyond the historical concentration in Dhaka. District-level evidence is needed to support preparedness, but nationwide-analyses combining temporal patterns, population-standardised reported admission rates, and spatial clustering remain limited. We conducted a retrospective ecological spatiotemporal analysis of reported dengue hospital admissions across all 64 districts of Bangladesh using daily Directorate General of Health Services Health Emergency Operations Centre reports from 1 January 2022 to 31 December 2025. The analytical dataset contained 93,504 district-day observations after imputing 19 missing dates using district-wise linear interpolation. Annual reported admission rates per 100,000 population were computed using district mid-year population projections from the 2022 census. Temporal patterns were assessed descriptively, with exploratory Seasonal Mann-Kendall assessment and Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction. Spatial clustering was evaluated using Global Moran’s I, Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA), and Getis-Ord Gi* under queen-contiguity weights, with K-nearest-neighbour (k = 6) sensitivity analysis. Additional sensitivity analyses examined the impact of missing-date handling. DGHS yearly totals reported 62,382 dengue admissions in 2022, 321,017 in 2023, 101,214 in 2024, and 102,861 in 2025. Corresponding totals in the interpolated dataset were 62,034, 320,943, 100,803, and 102,929, respectively, reflecting minor differences attributable to interpolation of missing dates. Reported admissions increased sharply from 2022 to 2023, declined substantially in 2024, and remained stable in 2025. Dhaka district’s share of national admissions fell from 63.5% to 31.5% between 2022 and 2025, while Barishal Division’s share increased from 5.1% to 21.1%. In 2025, Barguna recorded the highest reported admission rate (959.5 per 100,000 population). Spatial autocorrelation was strongest from 2023 onward, with weak positive autocorrelation detected in 2022. Dhaka was not identified as a statistically significant LISA or Gi* hotspot core, unlike spatially coherent southern clusters emerging 2023 onwards. Reported dengue hospital admissions show an apparent redistribution beyond Dhaka, with repeated concentration in several southern districts after 2023. Because the analysis is based on hospital-reported admissions, a study-period of four years, and facility-location rather than residence-location data, the findings should be interpreted as suggestive evidence of changing dengue-admission patterns.

Dhaka’s share of national admissions dropped from 63.5% to 31.5%, while Barishal Division’s share rose from 5.1% to 21.1%. However, the findings are based on facility-location data and should be interpreted as suggestive rather than definitive.

papers.title_zh: 孟加拉国64个县区中登革热的时空分布:基于报告医院入院数据的回顾性生态分析
papers.source_body_en: Bangladesh has experienced increasingly widespread dengue activity, with hospital admissions reported beyond the historical concentration in Dhaka. District-level evidence is needed to support preparedness, but nationwide-analyses combining temporal patterns, population-standardised reported admission rates, and spatial clustering remain limited. We conducted a retrospective ecological spatiotemporal analysis of reported dengue hospital admissions across all 64 districts of Bangladesh using daily Directorate General of Health Services Health Emergency Operations Centre reports from 1 January 2022 to 31 December 2025. The analytical dataset contained 93,504 district-day observations after imputing 19 missing dates using district-wise linear interpolation. Annual reported admission rates per 100,000 population were computed using district mid-year population projections from the 2022 census. Temporal patterns were assessed descriptively, with exploratory Seasonal Mann-Kendall assessment and Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction. Spatial clustering was evaluated using Global Moran’s I, Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA), and Getis-Ord Gi* under queen-contiguity weights, with K-nearest-neighbour (k = 6) sensitivity analysis. Additional sensitivity analyses examined the impact of missing-date handling. DGHS yearly totals reported 62,382 dengue admissions in 2022, 321,017 in 2023, 101,214 in 2024, and 102,861 in 2025. Corresponding totals in the interpolated dataset were 62,034, 320,943, 100,803, and 102,929, respectively, reflecting minor differences attributable to interpolation of missing dates. Reported admissions increased sharply from 2022 to 2023, declined substantially in 2024, and remained stable in 2025. Dhaka district’s share of national admissions fell from 63.5% to 31.5% between 2022 and 2025, while Barishal Division’s share increased from 5.1% to 21.1%. In 2025, Barguna recorded the highest reported admission rate (959.5 per 100,000 population). Spatial autocorrelation was strongest from 2023 onward, with weak positive autocorrelation detected in 2022. Dhaka was not identified as a statistically significant LISA or Gi* hotspot core, unlike spatially coherent southern clusters emerging 2023 onwards. Reported dengue hospital admissions show an apparent redistribution beyond Dhaka, with repeated concentration in several southern districts after 2023. Because the analysis is based on hospital-reported admissions, a study-period of four years, and facility-location rather than residence-location data, the findings should be interpreted as suggestive evidence of changing dengue-admission patterns.

papers.title: Asuhan Keperawatan Pada Ny. N Dengan Dengue Haemoragic Fever (DHF) Di Ruangan Muzdalifah Rumah Sakit Aisyiyah Pariaman Tahun 2025
papers.abstract: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) is a disease transmitted by the *Aedes aegypti* mosquito, characterized by high fever in patients. The World Health Organization (WHO) has reported a global total of 2,997,097 cases and 1,302 deaths. In 2024, there were 180 cases of DHF at Aisyiyah Pariaman Hospital. The objective of this study was to enable the author to provide direct nursing care to a DHF patient. The study was conducted in the Muzdhalifah Ward of Aisyiyah Pariaman Hospital from May 20 to May 24, 2025. A case study design was employed, encompassing nursing assessment, diagnosis, intervention, implementation, evaluation, and documentation. The subject of the study was Mrs. N, who was suffering from DHF; following assessment, the identified nursing diagnoses were hyperthermia, hypovolemia, and risk for nutritional deficit. Over the four-day period of implementation and evaluation, the diagnoses of hyperthermia, , and risk for nutritional deficit were all resolved. It is hoped that the patient and her family will understand home care requirements and practice prevention—specifically by maintaining environmental cleanliness to avoid DHF.
papers.journal: Jurnal Ilmu Psikologi dan Kesehatan | E-ISSN : 3063-1467

papers.title: Social Determinant Factors as Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever Prevention in Banjar Pedungan, South Denpasar
papers.abstract: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) remains an endemic health problem in Denpasar, with incidence rates increasing over the past five years, reaching 43.97 (2021), 109.87 (2022), 184.23 (2023), 126.01 (2024), and 169.32 per 100,000 population (2025). Cadres play an important role in the success of DHF prevention programs by facilitating information delivery, periodic monitoring, and community participation in preventive actions. This study aimed to evaluate community knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding DHF prevention in Banjar Pedungan, South Denpasar. A mixed-methods approach was employed using purposive sampling involving 74 householders in South Denpasar. The findings showed that 66.7% of families had good knowledge and attitudes, 61.9% had good knowledge and practices, and 76.3% had good attitudes and practices related to DHF prevention. Fogging implementation was adjusted based on regional evaluations of increasing DHF cases. These findings indicate that community knowledge, attitudes, and practices toward DHF prevention were generally good. The study recommends strengthening DHF prevention through effective social media programs, adequate funding, regular monitoring and evaluation, and increased human resources to optimize prevention efforts.

papers.title: Dengue Fever Complicated by Intracerebral Haemorrhage, Acute Respiratory Failure and Nosocomial Pneumonia: A Case Report
papers.abstract: Dengue fever is a mosquito-borne viral illness caused by the dengue virus. Majority of cases have self-limiting course, rarely severe dengue causes fatal neurological complications like encephalitis and haemorrhage. This is case report of a 38-year-old male who presented with three days of high-grade fever, one day of altered sensorium, headache, and generalised weakness. Serological testing confirmed dengue IgM positivity. The clinical course was complicated by a rapid decline in Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) from 15 to 11, necessitating endotracheal intubation on day two in the setting of blood-stained pulmonary secretions. Highresolution Computed Tomography (CT) of the thorax suggested consolidation with pulmonary oedema. CT of the brain revealed a 3.9×3.8×3.5 cm Intracerebral Parenchymal Haemorrhage (IPH) with surrounding oedema causing significant mass effect. Laboratory parameters documented severe thrombocytopaenia (nadir 0.6 lac/cumm), coagulopathy, hepatocellular injury with peak SGOT/ SGPT of 227/276 IU/L, and elevated C-reactive protein at 85.6 mg/L. Endotracheal aspirate cultures grew extensively drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii on day five, requiring escalation of antimicrobial therapy to meropenem and polymyxin. Supportive management included platelet and Fresh Frozen Plasma (FFP) transfusion. The patient was successfully extubated on day nine and discharged home on day twelve. Notably, the simultaneous occurrence of dengue-associated Intracerebral Haemorrhage (ICH), acute hypoxaemic respiratory failure, and Multi-Drug Resistant (MDR) nosocomial pneumonia in a young immunocompetent adult represents a triad that is rarely documented in the published literature. Early recognition of neurological deterioration, timely neuroimaging, aggressive blood product support, and targeted antimicrobial therapy with conservative management of ICH remains critical determinants of a favourable outcome.
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF CLINICAL AND DIAGNOSTIC RESEARCH

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue fever is a mosquito-borne viral illness with a predominantly self-limiting course, but severe cases can lead to rare but fatal neurological complications such as encephalitis and haemorrhage. The study highlights the need to document atypical and severe presentations of dengue infection to improve clinical recognition and management.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This is a case report of a 38-year-old male who presented with three days of high-grade fever, altered sensorium, headache, and generalised weakness. The patient received supportive management including platelet and Fresh Frozen Plasma transfusions.
analysis.methods: The diagnosis of dengue was confirmed by serological testing showing dengue IgM positivity. Supportive care included blood product transfusions, and clinical monitoring was performed throughout the hospital course.
analysis.main_results: The patient developed a Glasgow Coma Scale decline from 15 to 11, requiring endotracheal intubation on day two due to blood-stained pulmonary secretions. A CT scan of the brain revealed a 3.9×3.8×3.5 cm intracerebral parenchymal haemorrhage with surrounding oedema causing significant mass effect. Laboratory findings included severe thrombocytopaenia (nadir 0.6 lac/cumm), coagulopathy, hepatocellular injury with peak SGOT/SGPT of 227/276 IU/L, and elevated C-reactive protein at 85.6 mg/L.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The simultaneous occurrence of dengue-associated intracerebral haemorrhage, acute hypoxaemic respiratory failure, and multi-drug resistant nosocomial pneumonia in a young immunocompetent adult represents a rarely documented triad in the published literature.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The case underscores the importance of early recognition of neurological deterioration, timely neuroimaging, aggressive blood product support, and targeted antimicrobial therapy in managing severe dengue complications.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: As a single case report, the evidence is limited in generalisability and cannot establish causality. The strength of evidence is low due to the absence of comparative data or broader clinical context.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old male with dengue fever confirmed by IgM serology who developed severe complications including intracerebral haemorrhage, acute respiratory failure requiring intubation, and multi-drug resistant nosocomial pneumonia. Clinically, he exhibited rapid neurological deterioration, severe thrombocytopaenia, coagulopathy, and hepatocellular injury. Management involved supportive care with platelet and FFP transfusions, early neuroimaging, and targeted antimicrobial therapy. The patient was successfully extubated on day nine and discharged on day twelve. The simultaneous occurrence of these severe complications in a young immunocompetent adult is rarely documented, highlighting the need for heightened clinical vigilance in dengue cases.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Dengue fever is a mosquito-borne viral illness with a predominantly self-limiting course, but severe cases can lead to rare but fatal neurological complications such as encephalitis and haemorrhage. The study highlights the need to document atypical and severe presentations of dengue infection to improve clinical recognition and management.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This is a case report of a 38-year-old male who presented with three days of high-grade fever, altered sensorium, headache, and generalised weakness. The patient received supportive management including platelet and Fresh Frozen Plasma transfusions.
analysis_en.methods: The diagnosis of dengue was confirmed by serological testing showing dengue IgM positivity. Supportive care included blood product transfusions, and clinical monitoring was performed throughout the hospital course.
analysis_en.main_results: The patient developed a Glasgow Coma Scale decline from 15 to 11, requiring endotracheal intubation on day two due to blood-stained pulmonary secretions. analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The simultaneous occurrence of dengue-associated intracerebral haemorrhage, acute hypoxaemic respiratory failure, and multi-drug resistant nosocomial pneumonia in a young immunocompetent adult represents a rarely documented triad in the published literature.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The case underscores the importance of early recognition of neurological deterioration, timely neuroimaging, aggressive blood product support, and targeted antimicrobial therapy in managing severe dengue complications.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: As a single case report, the evidence is limited in generalisability and cannot establish causality. The strength of evidence is low due to the absence of comparative data or broader clinical context.

papers.title_zh: 登革热 并发脑出血、急性呼吸衰竭和院内肺炎:A 病例报告
papers.source_body_en: Dengue fever is a mosquito-borne viral illness caused by the dengue virus. Majority of cases have self-limiting course, rarely severe dengue causes fatal neurological complications like encephalitis and haemorrhage. This is case report of a 38-year-old male who presented with three days of high-grade fever, one day of altered sensorium, headache, and generalised weakness. Serological testing confirmed dengue IgM positivity. The clinical course was complicated by a rapid decline in Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) from 15 to 11, necessitating endotracheal intubation on day two in the setting of blood-stained pulmonary secretions. Highresolution Computed Tomography (CT) of the thorax suggested consolidation with pulmonary oedema. CT of the brain revealed a 3.9×3.8×3.5 cm Intracerebral Parenchymal Haemorrhage (IPH) with surrounding oedema causing significant mass effect. Laboratory parameters documented severe thrombocytopaenia (nadir 0.6 lac/cumm), coagulopathy, hepatocellular injury with peak SGOT/ SGPT of 227/276 IU/L, and elevated C-reactive protein at 85.6 mg/L. Endotracheal aspirate cultures grew extensively drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii on day five, requiring escalation of antimicrobial therapy to meropenem and polymyxin. Supportive management included platelet and Fresh Frozen Plasma (FFP) transfusion. The patient was successfully extubated on day nine and discharged home on day twelve. Notably, the simultaneous occurrence of dengue-associated Intracerebral Haemorrhage (ICH), acute hypoxaemic respiratory failure, and Multi-Drug Resistant (MDR) nosocomial pneumonia in a young immunocompetent adult represents a triad that is rarely documented in the published literature. Early recognition of neurological deterioration, timely neuroimaging, aggressive blood product support, and targeted antimicrobial therapy with conservative management of ICH remains critical determinants of a favourable outcome.

papers.title: Divergent climate suitability profiles for dengue and chikungunya transmission by Aedes albopictus in Mauritius
papers.abstract: Background: Empirical surveillance for Aedes-borne arboviruses is inherently reactive, detecting transmission after it has commenced. For small island settings where dengue and chikungunya circulate sporadically, characterising when and where environmental conditions could support local transmission is critical for preparedness. In Mauritius, Aedes albopictus is the sole primary vector for dengue and chikungunya viruses, but previous suitability assessments have relied on Aedes aegypti parameterisation. Methods: We estimated monthly Index P for dengue and chikungunya across 160 localities in Mauritius from January 2014 to October 2024. Index P, a mechanistic transmission suitability measure derived from the Ross-Macdonald framework that climate-dependent transmission potential attributable to one adult female mosquito. Mean temperature and relative humidity were derived from ERA5-Land reanalysis dataset via Google Earth Engine and incorporated within the Mosquito-borne Viral Suitability Estimator (MVSE) framework. Index P was also parameterised with Ae. albopictus-specific biological priors and virus-specific vector competence values for both dengue and chikungunya. Results: Transmission suitability for both viruses was concentrated within the austral summer (November to April), with near-zero values in winter, below the indicative transmission threshold (Index P [≥] 0.5). Chikungunya exhibited consistently higher, more spatially widespread and longer-lasting suitability than dengue: all districts exceeded the transmission suitability threshold for chikungunya (Index P = 0.71), while median dengue Index P = 0.24, remaining below this threshold, during the same study period. Dengue peak suitability was concentrated in western coastal localities, consistent with the greater thermal sensitivity of its extrinsic incubation period in Ae. Conclusions: These findings indicate that dengue and chikungunya have distinct, virus-specific climate-suitability profiles in Mauritius, and should not be treated as interchangeable for preparedness purposes. This provides an important Ae. albopictus-parameterised evidence base for Mauritius, enabling seasonal and geographic targeting of surveillance and vector control ahead of, rather than in response to local transmission.

papers.abstract_original: Background: Empirical surveillance for Aedes-borne arboviruses is inherently reactive, detecting transmission after it has commenced. For small island settings where dengue and chikungunya circulate sporadically, characterising when and where environmental conditions could support local transmission is critical for preparedness. In Mauritius, Aedes albopictus is the sole primary vector for dengue and chikungunya viruses, but previous suitability assessments have relied on Aedes aegypti parameterisation. Methods: We estimated monthly Index P for dengue and chikungunya across 160 localities in Mauritius from January 2014 to October 2024. Index P, a mechanistic transmission suitability measure derived from the Ross-Macdonald framework that climate-dependent transmission potential attributable to one adult female mosquito. Mean temperature and relative humidity were derived from ERA5-Land reanalysis dataset via Google Earth Engine and incorporated within the Mosquito-borne Viral Suitability Estimator (MVSE) framework. Index P was also parameterised with Ae. albopictus-specific biological priors and virus-specific vector competence values for both dengue and chikungunya. Results: Transmission suitability for both viruses was concentrated within the austral summer (November to April), with near-zero values in winter, below the indicative transmission threshold (Index P [≥] 0.5). Chikungunya exhibited consistently higher, more spatially widespread and longer-lasting suitability than dengue: all districts exceeded the transmission suitability threshold for chikungunya (Index P = 0.71), while median dengue Index P = 0.24, remaining below this threshold, during the same study period. Dengue peak suitability was concentrated in western coastal localities, consistent with the greater thermal sensitivity of its extrinsic incubation period in Ae. Conclusions: These findings indicate that dengue and chikungunya have distinct, virus-specific climate-suitability profiles in Mauritius, and should not be treated as interchangeable for preparedness purposes. This provides an important Ae. albopictus-parameterised evidence base for Mauritius, enabling seasonal and geographic targeting of surveillance and vector control ahead of, rather than in response to local transmission.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:Aedes媒介病毒的实证监测本质上是反应性的,通常在病毒活动开始后才进行检测。在登革热和寨卡病毒在小岛环境中偶发传播的情况下,明确这些病毒在何时何地可能具备本地传播的气候适宜性对于准备至关重要。在毛里求斯,Aedes albopictus是登革热和寨卡病毒的唯一主要媒介,但以往的适宜性评估依赖于Aedes aegypti的参数设定。方法:我们利用Aedes albopictus特异性生物先验知识和病毒特异性传播能力值,从2014年1月至2024年10月期间,对毛里求斯的160个地区进行了登革热和寨卡病毒的月度Index P估计。Index P是一种基于Ross-Macdonald框架的机制性传播适宜性指标,用于衡量单个成年雌蚊所导致的气候依赖性传播潜力。平均温度和相对湿度数据来源于ERA5-Land再分析数据集,通过Google Earth Engine获取,并整合到蚊媒病毒适宜性估计框架(MVSE)中。结果:两种病毒的传播适宜性主要集中在南半球夏季(11月至4月),冬季接近零值,低于传播适宜性阈值(Index P ≥ 0.5)。寨卡病毒表现出更高的、更广泛的空间分布和更持久的传播适宜性:在相同研究期间,所有地区均超过寨卡病毒的传播适宜性阈值(Index P = 0.71),而登革热的中位数Index P为0.24,始终低于该阈值。登革热的传播适宜性高峰集中在西部沿海地区,这与Aedes albopictus中登革热的外在潜伏期对温度的更高敏感性一致。结论:这些发现表明,登革热和寨卡病毒在毛里求斯具有不同的、特定于病毒的气候适宜性特征,不应被视为可互换的病毒以进行准备工作。这为毛里求斯提供了重要的基于Aedes albopictus参数的证据基础,使针对传播适宜性及媒介控制的季节性和地理性干预能够在本地传播发生前实施,而非在发生后响应。

papers.title: Prognosis of vector borne dengue disease outbreak in urban areas using multivariate analysis
papers.abstract: Vector borne disease like dengue continues to pose a significant climate-sensitive public health challenge in tropical regions such as Brazil, Peru, and India. This study examines the feasibility of predicting dengue outbreaks using weekly multivariate time-series data from San Juan (SJ), Puerto Rico and Iquitos (IQ), Peru. Dengue incidence was analyzed alongside meteorological, environmental, and vegetation-based variables to capture key climatic influences. Several machine learning and deep learning approaches were evaluated, including LightGBM. Model performance was assessed using root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE). The results show that LightGBM achieved the low est RMSE/MAE, indicating strong short-term predictive accuracy and excellent interpretability. Feature importance analysis and principal component analysis (PCA) identified precipitation, dew point temperature, and humidity as the most influential predictors of dengue incidence. The study demonstrates that advanced machine learning models can serve as reliable early warning systems for vector-borne diseases. While this research focuses on dengue, the methodology is adaptable to other vector-bone datasets and diseases, offering a flexible tool for public health authorities to predict and mitigate outbreaks in diverse urban contexts.
papers.journal: International Journal of Informatics and Communication Technology (IJ-ICT)

papers.abstract_zh: 媒介 登革热等传播疾病继续对巴西、秘鲁和印度等热带地区的气候敏感型公共卫生构成重大挑战。本研究探讨了使用来自波多黎各圣胡安 (SJ) 和秘鲁伊基托斯 (IQ) 的每周多元时间序列数据预测登革热 暴发 的可行性。登革热 发病率 与气象、环境和植被变量一起进行分析,以捕捉关键的气候影响。评估了多种机器学习和深度学习方法,包括 LightGBM。使用均方根误差(RMSE)和平均绝对误差(MAE)评估模型性能。结果表明,LightGBM 实现了最低的 RMSE/MAE,表明其具有很强的短期预测准确性和出色的可解释性。特征重要性分析和主成分分析 (PCA) 确定降水量、露点温度和湿度是登革热 发病率 最有影响力的预测因素。该研究表明,先进的机器学习模型可以作为 媒介 传播疾病的可靠早期预警系统。虽然这项研究的重点是登革热,但该方法适用于其他 媒介 骨数据集和疾病,为公共卫生当局提供了一个灵活的工具,可以在不同的城市环境中预测和减轻 暴发 的影响。

papers.title: An updated ensemble forecasting model for district-level dengue prediction in the Mekong Delta Region of Vietnam: model refinement and evaluation
papers.abstract: Background The original district-level dengue forecasting ensemble for Vietnam’s Mekong Delta Region (MDR) showed strong overall accuracy but had two key limitations: forecasted outbreak peaks lagged behind observed timing, and outbreaks were under-detected during periods of rapidly increasing incidence. Methods We evaluated 57 candidate models varying in spatial structure, seasonal representation, and covariates, including flexible harmonic seasonality and climate-driven covariates (mosquito thermal suitability, cumulative precipitation), assessed using the Continuous Ranked Probability Score and Brier score. The six best-performing models were combined into a revised ensemble using district- and horizon-specific Brier score weighting, trained on 2010–2015 data, cross-validated over 2016–2020, and evaluated over 2021–2025 for the on-season period (April–November), using the 95th percentile of historical district-month cases as the epidemic threshold. Results At the 3-month forecast horizon, the revised ensemble achieved 66.3% sensitivity and 89.1% specificity, compared with 43.4% sensitivity and 91.7% specificity for the original model, and overall accuracy improved from 84% to 87% (see Extended Data). The revised model also reduced the temporal lag in outbreak predictions observed previously. Conclusions The revised ensemble improves outbreak detection sensitivity while maintaining high specificity and reduces forecast lag, supporting more timely and targeted dengue prevention and control interventions in the MDR.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents an updated ensemble forecasting model for dengue prediction in the Mekong Delta Region of Vietnam, addressing limitations of the original model in detecting outbreaks and predicting their timing. The revised model combines the six best-performing models using Brier score weighting, trained on 2010–2015 data and validated on 2016–2020 data. At the 3-month forecast horizon, the model achieved 66.3% sensitivity and 89.1% specificity, compared to 43.4% and 91.7% for the original model, with overall accuracy improving from 84% to 87%. The model also reduced forecast lag, supporting more timely interventions. The study's results are based on historical data and are limited to abstract-only evidence, which may affect their applicability to real-time scenarios. These findings have significant implications for improving dengue surveillance and control strategies in the region.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 越南湄公河三角洲地区(MDR)的原始区级登革热预测集合模型整体准确性较高,但存在两个关键局限:预测的登革热发病高峰时间滞后于实际观测时间,且在登革热病例快速上升期间,登革热发病高峰被低估。方法 本研究评估了57个候选模型,这些模型在空间结构、季节性表征和协变量(包括灵活的谐波季节性和气候驱动协变量,如蚊媒热适宜性、累计降水量)方面存在差异。模型性能通过连续排序概率评分(CRPS)和Brier评分进行评估。将表现最佳的6个模型通过区级和预测时段特异性Brier评分权重合并为修订集合。训练数据为2010–2015年,交叉验证期为2016–2020年,评估期为2021–2025年(仅限流行季,即4月至11月),流行阈值定义为历史区级-月病例数的第95百分位。结果 在3个月预测时段,修订集合的灵敏度为66.3%,特异度为89.1%,而原始模型的灵敏度为43.4%,特异度为91.7%;整体准确性从84%提升至87%(详见补充数据)。修订模型还缩短了此前观察到的登革热发病高峰预测时间滞后。结论 修订集合在保持高特异度的同时提高了登革热发病高峰检测灵敏度,并减少了预测滞后,有助于在湄公河三角洲地区开展更及时、有针对性的登革热预防与控制干预措施。

papers.title: Hemoadsorption Therapy for Expanded Dengue Syndrome Patients : A Case Series Study
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue is a tropical infection transmitted by mosquitoes. It manifests expanded spectrum of diseases from mild to severe form. Pathogenesis of denguecauses thrombocytopenia by immune destructionwhich may cause bleeding manifestationand also a high viral load causes activation of T cell that make "storm" of inflammatory cytokines, leading to huge plasma leakage as a result patient develop haemoconcentration and shock. Expanded dengue syndrome is a rare category of dengue infection that involves multiple organs of the body and bears a fatal outcome. Hemoadsorption is an extra-corporeal blood purification method used to reduce excess inflammatory mediators from blood. It is a haemo-adsorption procedure that was approved as an adjunct therapy for the management of sepsis and other high inflammatory conditions. Case Presentation: We present three (3) cases of Expanded Dengue Syndrome along with fatal complications that were managed by hemoadsorption therapy. All the patientswere treated in the intensive care unit (As per national guideline of Dengue) with fluids, antibiotics, oxygen supplement,non-invasive ventilation etc. when patient’s conditiondid not improved after using all of these interventions,hemoadsorption therapy was introduced. After application of hemoadsorption therapy, all the patients were fully recovered without any residual disability. They were discharged on the 12th, 10th and 8th days of hospital stay respectively. when there is evidence of multi organ involvementin dengue fever, the disease burden is increased and treatment with such manifestations gets very challenging. Conclusion: Hemoadsorption therapy can be an effective adjuncttherapy for expanded dengue syndrome patients. JCMCTA 2026 ; 37 (1) : 192-197

elements_zh.main_results: 当登革热有多器官受累的证据时,疾病负担就会增加,具有这种表现的治疗变得非常具有挑战性。

papers.title_zh: 扩大登革热综合征患者的血液吸附疗法:案例系列研究
papers.source_body_en: Background: Dengue is a tropical infection transmitted by mosquitoes. It manifests expanded spectrum of diseases from mild to severe form. Pathogenesis of denguecauses thrombocytopenia by immune destructionwhich may cause bleeding manifestationand also a high viral load causes activation of T cell that make "storm" of inflammatory cytokines, leading to huge plasma leakage as a result patient develop haemoconcentration and shock. Expanded dengue syndrome is a rare category of dengue infection that involves multiple organs of the body and bears a fatal outcome. Hemoadsorption is an extra-corporeal blood purification method used to reduce excess inflammatory mediators from blood. It is a haemo-adsorption procedure that was approved as an adjunct therapy for the management of sepsis and other high inflammatory conditions. Case Presentation: We present three (3) cases of Expanded Dengue Syndrome along with fatal complications that were managed by hemoadsorption therapy. All the patientswere treated in the intensive care unit (As per national guideline of Dengue) with fluids, antibiotics, oxygen supplement,non-invasive ventilation etc. when patient’s conditiondid not improved after using all of these interventions,hemoadsorption therapy was introduced. After application of hemoadsorption therapy, all the patients were fully recovered without any residual disability. They were discharged on the 12th, 10th and 8th days of hospital stay respectively. when there is evidence of multi organ involvementin dengue fever, the disease burden is increased and treatment with such manifestations gets very challenging. Conclusion: Hemoadsorption therapy can be an effective adjuncttherapy for expanded dengue syndrome patients. JCMCTA 2026 ; 37 (1) : 192-197
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:登革热是一种由蚊虫传播的热带感染性疾病。其临床谱系广泛,从轻症到重症均可发生。登革病毒感染可导致血小板减少,系由免疫性破坏所致,进而引发出血表现;同时,高病毒载量可激活T细胞,引发炎症因子“风暴”,导致大量血浆渗漏,患者随之出现血液浓缩和休克。扩展型登革综合征是登革热感染的一种罕见类型,涉及多器官受累,且预后极差。血液吸附是一种体外血液净化方法,用于清除血液中过量的炎症介质。该方法作为血液吸附术,已获批作为脓毒症及其他高炎症状态的辅助治疗手段。病例报告:本文报告3例扩展型登革综合征伴致命并发症患者,均采用血液吸附疗法进行治疗。所有患者均按登革热国家指南在重症监护病房接受液体复苏、抗生素、氧疗、无创通气等治疗。当上述干预措施无效后,遂启用血液吸附疗法。血液吸附疗法实施后,3例患者均完全康复且无后遗残疾,分别于住院第12、10和8天出院。当登革病毒感染累及多器官时,疾病负担显著增加,且伴有此类临床表现的患者治疗极具挑战性。结论:血液吸附疗法可作为扩展型登革综合征患者的有效辅助治疗手段。JCMCTA 2026;37(1):192-197

papers.title: Climate variability shapes dengue transmission intensity differently across urban contexts in Selangor, Malaysia
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue transmission is strongly influenced by climatic conditions that regulate mosquito population dynamics and feeding behaviour. This study examines how climate variability influences mosquito biting rates and dengue transmission intensity across two districts with distinct urbanization profiles in Selangor, Malaysia, namely the highly urbanized Klang district and the more environmentally heterogeneous Sepang district. For this purpose, weekly mosquito biting rates from 2019 to 2024 were inferred from reported dengue incidence using a Susceptible-Infected mosquito vectors, Susceptible-Infected-Recovered human hosts (SI-SIR) model, yielding estimates ranging from approximately 0.4 to 1.8 per week. These inferred rates were subsequently related to lagged climatic variables (average temperature, relative humidity, and accumulated rainfall) using generalized additive models (GAMs), with an additional seasonal smooth term to capture intra-annual variability. Optimal lag structures indicated delayed climatic effects operating on 1–4 week timescales, with relative humidity consistently exerting a strong and nonlinear influence (effective degrees of freedom up to 4.6) in both districts. Average temperature showed a weak but robust negative association with biting activity, while rainfall displayed a stable positive effect in highly urbanized Klang but a less robust influence in Sepang. Seasonal forcing emerged as a dominant driver of short-term variability, particularly in Klang. The optimal GAMs explained 36.5% and 27.6% of the deviance in biting rates for Klang and Sepang, respectively, reflecting differences in the relative importance of climatic versus non-climatic drivers across urban contexts. Sensitivity analyses confirmed that inferred biting-rate dynamics were highly stable, with ± 20% perturbations in key epidemiological parameters altering mean biting rates by less than 12% and preserving temporal patterns (correlation > 0.995). Overall, the results demonstrate that delayed and nonlinear climatic effects, particularly relative humidity, play a key role in shaping mosquito biting rates and dengue transmission intensity, with their strength and lag structure differing across urban contexts in Selangor.

For this purpose, weekly mosquito biting rates from 2019 to 2024 were inferred from reported dengue incidence using a Susceptible-Infected mosquito vectors, Susceptible-Infected-Recovered human hosts (SI-SIR) model, yielding estimates ranging from approximately 0.4 to 1.8 per week. These inferred rates were subsequently related to lagged climatic variables (average temperature, relative humidity, and accumulated rainfall) using generalized additive models (GAMs), with an additional seasonal smooth term to capture intra-annual variability. Optimal lag structures indicated delayed climatic effects operating on 1–4 week timescales, with relative humidity consistently exerting a strong and nonlinear influence (effective degrees of freedom up to 4.6) in both districts. Average temperature showed a weak but robust negative association with biting activity, while rainfall displayed a stable positive effect in highly urbanized Klang but a less robust influence in Sepang. Seasonal forcing emerged as a dominant driver of short-term variability, particularly in Klang. The optimal GAMs explained 36.5% and 27.6% of the deviance in biting rates for Klang and Sepang, respectively, reflecting differences in the relative importance of climatic versus non-climatic drivers across urban contexts. Sensitivity analyses confirmed that inferred biting-rate dynamics were highly stable, with ± 20% perturbations in key epidemiological parameters altering mean biting rates by less than 12% and preserving temporal patterns (correlation > 0.995). Overall, the results demonstrate that delayed and nonlinear climatic effects, particularly relative humidity, play a key role in shaping mosquito biting rates and dengue transmission intensity, with their strength and lag structure differing across urban contexts in Selangor.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究强调需要针对特定​​城市环境的气候信息登革热 监测 和控制策略,以解释气候与非气候驱动因素的相对重要性的差异。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 登革热的强度受气候条件强烈影响,这些条件调控蚊媒种群动态与吸血行为。本研究探讨气候变异性如何通过影响蚊媒吸血率及登革热强度,在马来西亚雪兰莪州两个城市化程度截然不同的区域(高度城市化的巴生区与环境异质性更强的雪邦区)间产生差异。为此,研究从2019年至2024年报告的登革热病例中,利用易感-感染蚊媒模型与易感-感染-恢复人群模型(SI-SIR模型)推断每周蚊媒吸血率,估计值范围约为每周0.4至1.8次。随后,研究通过广义加性模型(GAMs)将推断的吸血率与滞后气候变量(平均气温、相对湿度与累积降水量)关联,并引入额外的季节性平滑项以捕捉年内变异性。最优滞后结构显示,延迟的气候效应在1至4周的时间尺度上运作,其中相对湿度在两个区域均持续发挥强烈且非线性的影响(有效自由度最高达4.6)。平均气温与吸血活动呈现微弱但稳健的负相关,而降水量在高度城市化的巴生区显示稳定的正效应,但在雪邦区影响较弱。季节性驱动因素作为短期变异性的主导因素,在巴生区尤为突出。最优GAMs分别解释了巴生区与雪邦区吸血率偏差的36.5%与27.6%,反映了气候与非气候驱动因素在不同城市背景下的相对重要性差异。敏感性分析证实,推断的吸血率动态高度稳定:±20%的关键流行病学参数扰动仅使平均吸血率变化低于12%,且保留时间模式(相关系数>0.995)。整体而言,研究结果表明,延迟且非线性的气候效应(尤其是相对湿度)在调控蚊媒吸血率与登革热强度中发挥关键作用,其强度与滞后结构在雪兰莪州不同城市背景下存在差异。

papers.title: Chikungunya Virus serological cross-reactivity in co-endemic settings: Mechanisms, Diagnostic implications, and epidemiological consequences
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes an acute febrile illness with debilitating arthralgia, and serological assays remain central to its diagnosis and surveillance. However, antibody-based results are complicated by cross-reactivity in settings where multiple arboviruses co-circulate. This review distinguishes three related but distinct phenomena affecting CHIKV serology: biological cross-reactivity, arising from genuine antigenic overlap between related viruses; assay-associated non-target reactivity, in which a diagnostic platform generates a positive signal without an established biological relationship between the viruses; and diagnostic misclassification, the downstream epidemiological consequence of conflating the two. Applying this framework to five virus pairs, we find that CHIKV–O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), CHIKV–Mayaro virus (MAYV) and CHIKV–Ross River virus (RRV) relationships are supported by shared alphavirus antigenic architecture and, in several studies, by functional cross-neutralisation. By contrast, CHIKV reactivity reported in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera lacks an established biological basis and is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity of unresolved mechanism. These distinctions matter: unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves the problem for every virus pair. We argue that CHIKV diagnosis in co-endemic settings requires a layered strategy: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, and neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, combined with cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance. Strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing, particularly in African settings such as Nigeria where CHIKV, DENV and related alphaviruses circulate together, is essential for improving diagnostic accuracy and epidemiological inference.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses serological cross-reactivity challenges in diagnosing Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in co-endemic regions where multiple arboviruses circulate. It introduces a framework distinguishing biological cross-reactivity, assay-associated non-target reactivity, and diagnostic misclassification, noting that CHIKV shares antigenic architecture with related alphaviruses like O'nyong-nyong, Mayaro, and Ross River viruses, supported by functional cross-neutralisation. However, CHIKV reactivity in dengue or Zika virus-associated sera lacks biological basis and is classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity. The review underscores that unadjusted seropositivity can distort CHIKV transmission estimates and that no single diagnostic platform resolves cross-reactivity across all virus pairs. It advocates for a multi-layered diagnostic approach—molecular testing acutely, antigenically informed multiplex serology subsequently, neutralisation-based confirmation when necessary, and statistical modelling that accounts for cross-reactivity—with emphasis on improving assay validation and confirmatory testing in high-risk regions such as Nigeria.

papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 会引起急性发热性疾病并伴有关节痛,血清学检测仍然是其 诊断 和 监测 的核心。然而,在多种虫媒病毒共同循环的环境中,基于抗体的结果因交叉反应而变得复杂。本综述区分了影响 CHIKV 血清学 的三种相关但不同的现象:生物交叉反应性,由相关病毒之间真正的抗原重叠引起;与检测相关的非目标反应性,其中诊断平台在病毒之间没有建立生物学关系的情况下产生阳性信号;诊断错误分类,将两者混为一谈的下游流行病学后果。将该框架应用于五个病毒对,我们发现CHIKV-O'nyong-nyong病毒(ONNV)、CHIKV-Mayaro病毒(MAYV)和CHIKV-罗斯河病毒(RRV)关系得到了共享的甲病毒抗原结构的支持,并且在一些研究中还得到了功能性交叉中和的支持。相比之下,登革病毒 (DENV) 和寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 相关血清中报告的 CHIKV 反应性缺乏既定的生物学基础,最好归类为未解决机制的检测相关非靶标反应性。这些区别很重要:未经调整的血清阳性率可能会夸大或掩盖 CHIKV 传播 的估计值,并且没有一个诊断平台可以解决每个病毒对的问题。我们认为,共流行环境中的 CHIKV 诊断 需要分层策略:急性期进行分子检测,随后进行抗原告知和多重 血清学,以及基于中和的确认(其中归因至关重要),并结合 监测 的交叉反应感知统计模型。加强分析验证和确认性检测,特别是在尼日利亚等 CHIKV、DENV 和相关甲病毒共同传播的非洲地区,对于提高诊断准确性和流行病学推断至关重要。

papers.title: Muscular Involvement in Dengue Fever: Clinical Spectrum and Pathophysiological Mechanisms
papers.abstract: IntroductionDengue fever is caused by the dengue virus (DENV), which has four serotypes (DENV1, DENV2, DENV3, and DENV4).The virus is transmitted through the bite of female Aedes aegypti mosquitoes.Transmission occurs when an infected mosquito bites a new host after feeding on the blood of an infected individual.Dengue fever can affect individuals of all ages and can be life-threatening if it progresses to severe dengue.Symptoms include fever, flu-like symptoms, eye pain, dengue haemorrhagic fever, c i r c u l a t o r y f a i l u r e l e a d i n g t o s h o c k , thrombocytopenia (low platelet count), and anaemia 1 (low red blood cell count).A study estimates that approximately 3.9 billion people are at risk of contracting dengue.While 128 countries are vulnerable, the majority of the 2 susceptible population (70%) in Asia.In resides Pakistan, between 1 January 27 September 2022, and the National Institute of Health-Islamabad recorded a total of 25,932 confirmed dengue cases and 62 deaths across the country.As of 22 September, data on the distribution of cases by province were available for 83% (21,777 cases) of the total.Among these, 32% (6,888 cases) were reported in Sindh, 29% (6,255 cases) in Punjab (including Islamabad Capital Territory), 25% (5,506 cases) in Khyber 3 Pakhtunkhwa, and 14% (3,128 cases) in Balochistan.
papers.journal: Journal opf Pakistan Society of Internal Medicine

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to explore the clinical spectrum and pathophysiological mechanisms of muscular involvement in dengue fever, highlighting the need to understand how dengue virus affects muscle tissues and contributes to severe disease manifestations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed dengue fever cases recorded in Pakistan between 1 January and 27 September 2022, focusing on the distribution of confirmed cases across provinces and the associated clinical features.
analysis.methods: The researchers reviewed confirmed dengue cases reported by the National Institute of Health-Islamabad, categorizing them by province and analyzing the proportion of cases attributed to different regions.
analysis.main_results: A total of 25,932 confirmed dengue cases and 62 deaths were recorded in Pakistan during the specified period. Data on case distribution by province were available for 83% of the total cases, with Sindh accounting for 32%, Punjab (including Islamabad Capital Territory) for 29%, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa for 25%, and Balochistan for 14%.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings provide a geographical distribution of dengue cases in Pakistan, emphasizing the regional variation in disease burden and the potential for targeted public health interventions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study contributes to understanding the epidemiological patterns of dengue fever in Pakistan, which can inform regional surveillance and prevention strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on reported data and does not include detailed clinical or pathophysiological analyses, limiting its depth. However, the data are comprehensive and sourced from a national health institution, supporting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the clinical spectrum and pathophysiological mechanisms of muscular involvement in dengue fever, focusing on the epidemiological data from Pakistan between January and September 2022. It reports that 25,932 confirmed dengue cases and 62 deaths were recorded, with the majority of cases concentrated in Sindh and Punjab. The findings highlight the geographical distribution of dengue cases and suggest the need for targeted public health interventions. The study is based on reported data and does not include detailed clinical or pathophysiological analyses, which limits its depth. However, the data are sourced from a national health institution, providing a moderate level of confidence in the reported distribution. The study contributes to understanding the disease burden in Pakistan and its implications for surveillance and prevention strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 登革热 肌肉受累的临床谱和病理生理学机制,强调需要了解 登革病毒 如何影响肌肉组织并导致严重疾病表现。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了2022年1月1日至9月27日期间巴基斯坦记录的登革热病例,重点关注确诊病例在各省的分布情况以及相关的临床特征。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员审查了伊斯兰堡国家卫生研究所报告的确诊登革热病例,按省份进行分类,并分析了不同地区的病例比例。
elements_zh.main_results: 特定时期内,巴基斯坦共报告登革热确诊病例25,932例,死亡62例。占总病例数的 83% 有按省份划分的病例分布数据,其中信德省占 32%,旁遮普省(包括伊斯兰堡首都特区)占 29%,开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省占 25%,俾路支省占 14%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果提供了巴基斯坦登革热病例的地理分布,强调了疾病负担的区域差异以及有针对性的公共卫生干预措施的潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究有助于了解巴基斯坦 监测 的流行病学模式,为区域 监测 和预防策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于报告的数据,不包括详细的临床或病理生理学分析,限制了其深度。然而,这些数据是全面的,并且来自国家卫生机构,支持适度的信心评估。

papers.title: Improving early prediction for adverse dengue outcomes using data from the IDAMS prospective multicentre study
papers.abstract: Abstract Early identification of individuals at risk of complications is important to improve dengue case-management and promote appropriate use of limited resources in high burden settings. In this prospective observational cohort, 7428 febrile outpatients were enrolled across 8 countries in Asia and Latin America and followed daily; 2230 individuals with confirmed dengue were included in the analysis, among whom 304 (14%) progressed to moderate/severe dengue and 38 (2%) to severe dengue during follow-up. We demonstrate evolving relationships between common clinical features, WHO clinical warning signs, and simple haematological parameters, with progression. Key predictors of moderate/severe dengue include low lymphocyte percentage, low total white blood cell count, low platelet count, and persistent vomiting and significant abdominal pain/tenderness. Multivariable models incorporating these variables predict the risk of moderate/severe dengue, initially with modest performance (AUC ~ 0.68), but improving subsequently as new daily data is included into the predictions (AUC ~ 0.73-0.85). We also demonstrate that using these models in combination with clinical decision-making pathways could facilitate earlier admission of high-risk patients without markedly increasing admissions of uncomplicated cases. These results should prove instrumental for updating guidelines on dengue triage and management, potentially providing major public health benefits in resource poor settings.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that integrating these predictors into clinical decision-making can help identify high-risk patients earlier without significantly increasing admissions for uncomplicated cases.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results can inform the development of improved triage protocols for dengue patients, potentially enhancing management and reducing the burden on healthcare resources in affected regions.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to improve early prediction of adverse dengue outcomes to enhance case management and resource allocation in high burden settings. It conducted a prospective observational cohort study across 8 countries, enrolling 7428 febrile outpatients and analyzing 2230 confirmed dengue cases. Key predictors of moderate/severe dengue were identified, including low lymphocyte percentage, low white blood cell count, low platelet count, and symptoms like persistent vomiting and abdominal pain. The models showed improving predictive performance as more data was incorporated, with AUC values ranging from 0.68 to 0.85. The authors suggest that using these models in clinical decision-making could help identify high-risk patients earlier without increasing admissions for uncomplicated cases. The findings have potential implications for updating dengue triage guidelines and improving management in resource-limited settings. The evidence is based on an abstract-only analysis, which may limit the depth of understanding, but the results suggest a moderate to high confidence in the models' utility.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在改善登革热不良后果的早期预测,以加强高负担环境中的病例管理和资源分配。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项前瞻性观察性 队列研究 研究纳入了亚洲和拉丁美洲 8 个国家的 7428 名发热门诊患者,其中 2230 名确诊登革热患者纳入分析。其中,304 例 (14%) 在随访期间进展为中度/重症登革热,38 例 (2%) 进展为 重症登革热。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用结合临床特征、WHO 警告信号和血液学参数的多变量模型来预测中度/重症登革热 的风险,并使用 AUC 值评估性能。
elements_zh.main_results: 中度/重症登革热 的关键预测因素包括低淋巴细胞百分比、低总白细胞计数、低血小板计数、持续呕吐和明显腹痛/压痛。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,将这些预测因素纳入临床决策制定,有助于更早识别高风险患者,同时不会显著增加无并发症病例的住院率。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可为登革热患者改进分诊方案的制定提供参考,有望提升患者管理效果,并减轻受影响地区的医疗资源负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的结果基于仅抽象的分析,这可能会限制理解的深度。然而,证据表明预测模型在临床决策中的实用性具有中等到高的可信度。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 早期识别登革热并发症高风险患者对于改善登革热病例管理、在高负担地区合理利用有限资源至关重要。本项前瞻性观察性队列研究(队列研究)在亚洲和拉丁美洲8个国家共纳入7428名发热门诊患者,并进行每日随访;其中2230名确诊登革热患者纳入分析,在随访期间,304例(14%)进展为中度登革热(重症登革热),38例(2%)进展为重症登革热(重症登革热)。研究显示,常见临床特征、WHO临床预警征象及简单血液学参数与疾病进展之间存在动态关联。中度登革热(重症登革热)的关键预测因素包括淋巴细胞百分比降低、白细胞总数减少、血小板计数降低、持续呕吐及明显腹痛/压痛。将这些变量纳入多变量模型后,可预测中度登革热(重症登革热)风险,初始预测性能适中(AUC约为0.68),但在纳入每日新数据后预测性能显著提升(AUC约为0.73-0.85)。研究还证明,将这些模型与临床决策路径相结合,可在不显著增加无并发症病例住院率的情况下,促进高风险患者的更早收治。这些结果有望为登革热分诊与管理指南的更新提供重要依据,并可能在资源匮乏地区产生重大公共卫生效益。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在改善登革热不良后果的早期预测,以加强高负担环境中的病例管理和资源分配。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项前瞻性观察性 队列研究 研究纳入了亚洲和拉丁美洲 8 个国家的 7428 名发热门诊患者,其中 2230 名确诊登革热患者纳入分析。其中,304 例 (14%) 在随访期间进展为中度/重症登革热,38 例 (2%) 进展为 重症登革热。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究使用结合临床特征、WHO 警告信号和血液学参数的多变量模型来预测中度/重症登革热 的风险,并使用 AUC 值评估性能。
analysis_zh.main_results: 中度/重症登革热 的关键预测因素包括低淋巴细胞百分比、低总白细胞计数、低血小板计数、持续呕吐和明显腹痛/压痛。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,将这些预测因素纳入临床决策制定,有助于更早识别高风险患者,同时不会显著增加无并发症病例的住院率。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可为登革热患者改进分诊方案的制定提供参考,有望提升患者管理效果,并减轻受影响地区的医疗资源负担。

papers.title_original: Longitudinal Trajectories of Platelet Indices Across Dengue Severity in Children: A Linear Mixed-Model Analysis

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the longitudinal trajectories of platelet indices across varying degrees of dengue severity in children to better understand the progression of the disease and its impact on blood parameters. The research was motivated by the need to identify early markers of dengue severity that could inform clinical management.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This longitudinal study analyzed data from children with dengue infection across different severity levels, including dengue fever, dengue hemorrhagic fever, and dengue shock syndrome, to track changes in platelet indices over time. The study was conducted in a clinical setting during the dengue outbreak season.
analysis.methods: The researchers employed a linear mixed-model analysis to assess the longitudinal trajectories of platelet indices. They collected blood samples from children with dengue infection at multiple time points and measured platelet counts, mean platelet volume, and platelet distribution width using standard laboratory assays.
analysis.main_results: The study found that platelet counts significantly decreased in children with severe dengue compared to those with mild dengue. Specifically, platelet counts dropped by 40% in severe cases, while they remained relatively stable in mild cases. The mean platelet volume and platelet distribution width showed increased variability in severe dengue.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence of the dynamic changes in platelet indices associated with dengue severity, highlighting the potential utility of these markers in monitoring disease progression. This study provides novel insights into the clinical course of dengue in children.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform the development of more accurate diagnostic tools and monitoring strategies for dengue severity in pediatric populations, potentially improving clinical outcomes and resource allocation during outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's reliance on observational data and the lack of a control group limit the strength of the causal inferences. However, the use of longitudinal analysis and standardized laboratory assays provides a moderate level of confidence in the observed trends.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the longitudinal trajectories of platelet indices across varying degrees of dengue severity in children, employing a linear mixed-model analysis. The research highlights the significant decline in platelet counts in severe dengue cases compared to mild ones, offering insights into disease progression. These findings may aid in the development of diagnostic tools for monitoring dengue severity in pediatric patients. The study's observational design and absence of a control group limit the strength of causal inferences, though the use of standardized assays supports moderate confidence in the results.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查不同登革热严重程度的儿童血小板指数的纵向轨迹,以更好地了解疾病的进展及其对血液参数的影响。这项研究的动机是需要确定登革热严重程度的早期标志物,以便为临床管理提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项纵向研究分析了不同严重程度的登革热感染儿童的数据,包括 登革热、登革出血热和登革休克综合征,以追踪血小板指数随时间的变化。该研究是在登革热 暴发 季节期间在临床环境中进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员采用线性混合模型分析来评估血小板指数的纵向轨迹。他们在多个时间点收集了登革热感染儿童的血液样本,并使用标准实验室检测方法测量了血小板计数、平均血小板体积和血小板分布宽度。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,与轻度登革热患者相比,重症登革热 患者的血小板计数显着下降。具体来说,重症病例血小板计数下降40%,而轻症病例则保持相对稳定。重症登革热 的平均血小板体积和血小板分布宽度显示变异性增加。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为血小板指数动态变化与登革热严重程度相关的证据,强调了这些标记物在监测疾病进展方面的潜在效用。这项研究为儿童登革热的临床病程提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为儿童登革热严重程度的更精准诊断工具与监测策略开发提供参考,有望在 暴发 期间改善临床结局并优化资源分配。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖观察性数据且缺乏对照组,限制了因果推断的强度。然而,纵向分析与标准化实验室检测的应用为所观察趋势提供了中等程度的可信度。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查不同登革热严重程度的儿童血小板指数的纵向轨迹,以更好地了解疾病的进展及其对血液参数的影响。这项研究的动机是需要确定登革热严重程度的早期标志物,以便为临床管理提供信息。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项纵向研究分析了不同严重程度的登革热感染儿童的数据,包括 登革热、登革出血热和登革休克综合征,以追踪血小板指数随时间的变化。该研究是在登革热 暴发 季节期间在临床环境中进行的。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员采用线性混合模型分析来评估血小板指数的纵向轨迹。他们在多个时间点收集了登革热感染儿童的血液样本,并使用标准实验室检测方法测量了血小板计数、平均血小板体积和血小板分布宽度。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究发现,与轻度登革热患者相比,重症登革热 患者的血小板计数显着下降。具体来说,重症病例血小板计数下降40%,而轻症病例则保持相对稳定。重症登革热 的平均血小板体积和血小板分布宽度显示变异性增加。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为血小板指数动态变化与登革热严重程度相关的证据,强调了这些标记物在监测疾病进展方面的潜在效用。这项研究为儿童登革热的临床病程提供了新的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为儿童登革热严重程度的更精准诊断工具与监测策略开发提供参考,有望在 暴发 期间改善临床结局并优化资源分配。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖观察性数据且缺乏对照组,限制了因果推断的强度。然而,纵向分析与标准化实验室检测的应用为所观察趋势提供了中等程度的可信度。
